chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - summary
After a long tech-troubleshooting preamble, the party met in Alderville, where Muto and Asher carried Uton's soup to Refugee Camp Number 11. A group of drunk Red Hawk recruits harassed a Filanese girl, and the party beat them down nonlethally until one surrendered, while a Red Hawk sergeant and an army rider looked on. Captain Holcroft hustled the party into the tower to await the mayor's daughter, and Muto then proposed investigating his father Uton's old homestead during the Triskelion. At the homestead the party fought vine and needle blights and a charm-singing harpy, harvested their parts, and found a pile of cadavers inside.
Cliffhanger: The harpy and blights are dead and the party has harvested from them, but dusk has fallen on the night of the Triskelion, and Mark warns that things are likely to start bumping as soon as darkness falls, with the house full of cadavers and not safe to rest in.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - Tech Troubles and House Rules
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - scene 1: Tech Troubles and House Rules
- Mark waited out audio and video problems, including Dwayne's Discord input device switching.
- Mark explained the perfect-crit damage option for this week and worried it could trivialize combat and force harder encounters.
- Corwynn found his hit points were wrong (14 instead of 10), and Mark corrected them and promised to reaudit the sheets.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - Soup for the Camp
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - scene 2: Soup for the Camp
- Muto brought herbs to Carter Maine's shop, where Uton and Asher were working.
- Uton ladled soup into jars and told Muto and Asher to take the racks to the refugee camp promptly.
- They carried the soup past the militia fort and across the bridge to Refugee Camp Number 11.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - Red Hawks at the Camp
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - scene 3: Red Hawks at the Camp
- Drunken shouting rose as five Red Hawk recruits in studded leather ringed a terrified Filanese girl.
- Elric tried to stall and persuade them but was told to piss off, and Corwynn was called Cyclops.
- Garuet made a running 17-foot jump to land beside them, declaring the girl was on her team.
- The militia would not intervene unless blood was drawn, and initiative was rolled.
- One recruit dropped his club and surrendered, and the girl, who had fainted, woke and admired Garuet.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - Aftermath and the Tower
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - scene 4: Aftermath and the Tower
- Captain Holcroft arrived as a Red Hawk sergeant and an army rider reined in nearby, and the sergeant had the survivor check his comrades.
- The sergeant gave a two-finger salute and rode off with the wounded draped over horses.
- Holcroft thanked the party, said Mayor Woodson wanted to speak with them, and took them to the tower to stay out of sight.
- The mayor's daughter arrived after a little over an hour.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - Planning the Trip
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - scene 5: Planning the Trip
- Muto proposed visiting his father's old homestead during the Triskelion, and the party agreed.
- Mark noted that the robbed recruit carried about three silver pieces.
- Asher told Carter Maine the plan and got two Animus jars from him.
- Muto said goodbye to Uton, who drifted in and out of lucidity and said he missed the old house.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - The Old Homestead
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - scene 6: The Old Homestead
- After hours of bushwhacking led by Muto, the party reached the abandoned cabin.
- Corwynn smelled rotting flesh, and two corpses and guano-coated trees were spotted.
- Vines lashed out and a vine blight and needle blights attacked, with Garuet's perfect crit exploding one.
- The vine creature's entangling effect restrained Elric and Garuet.
- A harpy's song charmed Corwynn, Asher, Elric and Garuet until Muto's Starry Wisp broke her concentration.
- Garuet's trident toppled the harpy from the tree and Muto killed her with his staff.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - Harvesting and Searching
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - scene 7: Harvesting and Searching
- Each character harvested one part, with Elric taking vine bark.
- The harpy had been nesting in the house, and the searchers found a pile of partly eaten cadavers.
- Mark awarded experience for completing Muto's short-term goal, and the session ended as darkness and the Triskelion approached.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-14: Soup, Goat Ball, and Harpy Song - memorable quotes
- "Time for our evening game of goat ball. Excuse me, boys, but she's on my team." - Garuet (Steph)
- "You shouldn't have made me angry. You won't like me when I're angry." - Garuet (Steph)
- "I guess you didn't get the hint from that dagger." - Allyn (Dwayne)
- "One of these days, I'm gonna actually learn how to play Dungeons and Dragons." - Allyn (Dwayne)
- "It's gardening. She's weeding the garden." - Asher (Jim)
- "I feel mesmerized, but it's still lovely." - Garuet (Steph)
- "Okay. I will swing. Let's cross our fingers for Cleavomatic." - Garuet (Steph)

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-28: Episode 2 -- A Simple Favor - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-28: Episode 2 -- A Simple Favor - summary
The party camped outside Muto's old homestead, had prophetic dreams, and woke to find Muto's mentor Verdina Woodwise, who explained the Triskelion and assigned them the nearer rifts. They traveled to an ancient tree, waited out nightfall, and fought four darklings that emerged from a rift. Asher closed the rift with magic missiles and the party looted gems, coins, a potion and boots. Traveling toward the next rift site, they fought six dust and mud mephits at a marshy crossing and defeated them all.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-11: Episode 3--Big Night - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-11: Episode 3--Big Night - summary
Traveling the Alderwood at night during the Triskelion, the party patched up with Corwynn's healing kit, hid their trail from a gnoll pack, and reached the second rift. There they found goblins led by a robed spellcaster ritually upgrading the rift into a portal, and Asher learned this by casting Comprehend Languages. After an ambush opened by Allyn, a hard fight saw several PCs downed before Muto killed the spellcaster. The party destroyed the glowing stone table to close the Feywild rift, leveled up to 2, looted the camp, and prepared to long rest at dawn.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-25: Episode 4 -- Only When I Laugh - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-25: Episode 4 -- Only When I Laugh - summary
On the second day of Triskelion, Muto's Detect Magic ritual identified the party's loot, including the Boots of False Tracks, and the healing potion went to Garuet. The party scouted rift B from a hill and found a clearing of standing stones guarded by fiendish creatures. They killed the creatures in a fight while the stones formed a portal. Magic from range failed against the rift, so they attacked it in melee, and the session ended with something clawing through.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-09: Episode 5 -- Something Wicked - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-09: Episode 5 -- Something Wicked - summary
The party's attempt to close the first rift was interrupted by a fiendish Cerberus, which they killed after Garuet's cleave collapsed the rift. They harvested its parts, then traveled through marsh to the final rift site, where they fought boggles and nilbogs trying to force a rift open. They won, looted coins, a potion and a carved bird staff, and settled in to rest. During the rest a bird carried Verdina's plea for rescue from gnolls at the Ancient Plinth Altar, about eight hours away, by midnight.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-23: Episode 6 -- Rescue Me! - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-23: Episode 6 -- Rescue Me! - summary
Racing against Verdina's midnight deadline, the party opened a Fae gate with boggle oil and cackler teeth and crossed the Feywild. They won the grinning cat's aid with the Cerberus heart, rested while the pseudo-dragon paused time, and exited near Red Bark Grove. They then fought through gnolls and hyenas at the Plinth Altar and rescued Verdina, who left after drinking her own blood. They met Fordan, learned it was safe to return to town, and reached level 3.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-06: Episode 7 -- Wicked Little Letters - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-06: Episode 7 -- Wicked Little Letters - summary
The party returned to Aldervale and split up: Corwynn collected mail, including an ornate House Vira letter for Brother Elric, while Asher and Muto visited Carder Mane's shop. Uton revealed to Muto his Feywild bargain and secret alchemy, Allyn overheard the Mayor and Captain Holcroft, and Garuet learned from Mira of a possible rare forge at Vestalin. Hovan Garth extended Allyn's debt by a month and tasked him with disrupting press gang caravans by the ninth of Life. The party decided to prioritize the caravans, perhaps visiting Vestalin afterward.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-20: Episode 8 -- Along Came a Spider - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-20: Episode 8 -- Along Came a Spider - summary
Garuet bought scale mail from Mira with help from the party, and Carder Mane identified the party's magic items. Traveling through the woods toward the slave caravan rendezvous, the party fought giant spiders and a phase spider, Murray, at a chasm that seems to lead to the Underdark. Later they found a wrecked wagon and a dying former Red Hawk who mistook Corwynn for someone else, plus a shattered magic staff.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-04: Episode 9--Paint Your Wagon (part 1) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-04: Episode 9--Paint Your Wagon (part 1) - summary
The party found a ransacked supply wagon and a dying Red Hawk mercenary, then used a groundhog witness and tracks to find a waterfall cave. They killed two worgs and two ogres and freed eight Pfilenese prisoners. A hidden compartment held a coded ledger, coins and a letter linking Baron Elias Jorund to a press gang delivering miners to General August in Vestalin. They camped in the cave and planned to pursue the other caravan.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-18: Episode 10--Paint Your Wagon (part 2) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-18: Episode 10--Paint Your Wagon (part 2) - summary
The party woke in the ogre cave, burned the ogre corpses and questioned the freed prisoners. Andric and Sandor identified the dead Red Hawk as Bergher, named House Jorund as the slavers' master and gave directions to the rendezvous. After leaving the prisoners behind and burying the first caravan's dead, the party found a second slaver camp on a stream bank and ambushed it at night, defeating the slavers without losing anyone and freeing more captives. Afterward the group, led by Allyn's complaints, agreed to hold a post-mortem on tactics and coordination before the next session.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-01: Episode 11-- Tea & Sympathy - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-01: Episode 11-- Tea & Sympathy - summary
The party examined the loot from the slaver ambush, freed six more refugees, hid the cage wagon, and brought both refugee groups to Aldervale's camp. They leveled to fourth level, crafted armor at Carder's shop, and had items identified. The Mayor reacted with alarm to the press-ganged refugees, and the Countess received them for tea, approved of their actions and warned them about the King's Writ. Raeve Amel then asked them to investigate a creature haunting the refugee camp, and the children's accounts began the inquiry.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-15: Episode 12 -- Skulk - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-15: Episode 12 -- Skulk - summary
On the 11th of Life, the party worked on decoding the ledger from the ogre cave, tying Lyndon Jorund to its entries. Garuet and Allyn investigated missing refugees at the camp, and Carder Mane identified the culprit as skulks and made a charnel candle. That night Allyn baited a trap and the party killed three skulks, with child Johni helping spot them and being wounded and healed. The militia took the bodies and the party harvested components.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-29: Episode 13 -- The Conversation(s) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-29: Episode 13 -- The Conversation(s) - summary
On the 10th of Life, Aldervale prepared for Bright Night while the party worked on refugee aid, Muto's homestead plan and the Jorund ledger. Corwynn found his family's attack recorded in it. Countess Hargan returned, and Muto learned she vanished for a day. On the 11th, House Jorund's delegation arrived at the Mountain Inn, where Garuet and a Ra' Vager Goliath guard faced off, and Elric hid from his brother Ames.

chunks.title: Session 2026-02-12: Episode 14 -- House of Games - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-12: Episode 14 -- House of Games - summary
Baron Elias Jorund and his heir Lyndon arrived in Aldervale, and Garuet had a tense standoff with Lyndon's Goliath Ronan, defused by Asher's illusion. Allyn played cards with Horst, Horton and Winfield at the Thief & Chain, while Asher befriended Ames Caelwyn. Allyn's clumsy probing about Vestalin made Lyndon leave, though Horst let slip that something in the tunnels is eating miners. The party then spotted Ronan lurking in nearby trees, found his boot prints, and concluded they were being surveilled, and discussed plans toward Bright Night.

chunks.title: Session 2026-03-12: Episode 15--The Cave - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-03-12: Episode 15--The Cave - summary
The Countess summoned the party to lunch, where she revealed she knows Elric's identity, warned them about Baron Jorand and promised Garuet justice. Told to leave town until Bright Night Eve, they escorted refugee families and Andric to resettle Muto's family homestead. They then descended the 180-foot chasm into the Underdark and were ambushed by camouflaged cave predators. The session ended with Allyn suffocating and Muto grappled and poisoned.

chunks.title: Session 2026-03-26: Episode 16--The Cave (part 2) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-03-26: Episode 16--The Cave (part 2) - summary
In the Underdark cavern the party killed a darkmantle, a roper and piercers; Allyn killed the darkmantle from within and the roper fell after Corwynn's guiding bolt. They found a dead adventurer's valise and fist-sized gold nuggets in the roper, harvested rare materials and rested. In a glowing fungus cavern they collected samples for Carder Mane and destroyed a stirge swarm, Garuet finishing it with a greataxe sweep. Following birdsong, they emerged into a glade in the Alderwood at evening, planning to return.

chunks.title: Session 2026-04-09: Episode 17--The Cave (part 3) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-04-09: Episode 17--The Cave (part 3) - summary
The party looted the roper's victim, harvested the roper, and camped overnight in the Alderwood glade. The next day they followed a new streamlet underground, chose the spiral passage over a descending tunnel, and reached a glowing fungus cavern where Asher gathered specimens for Carder Mane. Two Beetle Knights and a hulking insectoid burst from a crevasse and a stone column, and the party killed them, with Garuet landing the final blow. They harvested components, planned recipe research, and prepared to return for the Aldervale festival. The GM announced everyone should level up to level five.

chunks.title: Session 2026-04-23: Episode 18 -- White Night - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-04-23: Episode 18 -- White Night - summary
After resting in the cavern and debating goals, the party retrieved a treasure parcel from an Umber Hulk nest via Muto's spider form and climbed out through the Spider Cleft. They passed the homestead, where Muto stayed to bless the land, then returned to Aldervale for White Night. The Countess's letter warned them off her masked ball, and Allyn heeded it after Muto's Augury. Asher helped with the fireworks and Elric gathered intelligence on Vestalin. They planned to bring Elric's brother Ames to Carder Mane's shop.

chunks.title: Session 2026-05-07: Episode 19--The Duel - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-05-07: Episode 19--The Duel - summary
The morning after White Night, the party examined Underdark loot, and Asher identified a Drow scroll with Water Breathing and Faerie Fire plus a cold resistance potion. Ames recognized Brother Elric as his supposedly dead brother Eldran, and they reunited on the bridge. Ronan then challenged Garuet to an honor duel. After scouting and negotiating, Garuet beat him with a glaive at the lumber mill, and the nobles abandoned him.

chunks.title: Session 2026-05-21: Episode 20--Aftermath - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-05-21: Episode 20--Aftermath - summary
The morning after the duel, the visiting nobles had fled Aldervale. Garuet interviewed Ronan, learned both clans were manipulated, and renamed him Tarvhik Gothakut after a Geas seizure stopped him from naming House Jorund. Muto consulted Verdina in the Alderwood about rifts and Vestalin. The Countess pledged to protect Tarvhik, backed Elric's priory, and warned of Baron Jorund's fury and Vestalin's dangers. The party crafted two more animus jars and decided to travel north via Jessain to the Gem Lakes.

chunks.title: Session 2026-06-04: Episode 21--The Road - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-06-04: Episode 21--The Road - summary
In Aldervale, Corwynn freed Ronan of the Jorunds' Geas, and the party prepared for the journey north by crafting two healing potions and paying Andric for information on Vestalin. Brother Elric shared his order's letter about an abandoned holdfast. The party left the road to avoid Redhawk patrols and climbed to a cliff-side monastery in the Berius Mountains. They fought and destroyed ghasts and a skull-faced wight, then took a long rest in the cleared ruin.

chunks.title: Session 2026-06-18: Episode 22--The Road (part 2) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-06-18: Episode 22--The Road (part 2) - summary
The party rested in the abandoned mountain temple, absorbed Tarvhik's intelligence on House Jorund, the Ravagers and the surprising claim that Countess Hargan is neutral to the Baron, and divided the loot from the ghasts and wight. Muto's owl was destroyed by a spectral entity in a sinkhole cavern, so the party moved on north. They camped one night and then crossed into Pfilen, where bugbear stalkers ambushed them at a stream ford and were routed, mostly by Asher's bouncing Chromatic Orb. They then agreed to enter Jessain openly to find Allyn's sister Thea.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-02: Episode 23--The Town - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-02: Episode 23--The Town - summary
The party looted the bugbear camp, took the goods west along the coast road, and entered occupied Jessain posing as traders. They traded flour for a bread letter of credit with baker Bob Smith and donated it to the Brothers of the Silent Step, where Brother Bob explained the political situation. Allyn and Garuet found Allyn's sister Thea at the Salty Sailor and were brought to a meeting with the deposed Baron Anton LeFlay and Hovan Garth. The Baron revealed a past tie to Garuet's Goliath clan and wishes to conspire with Allyn about Pfilen's future.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-16: Episode 24--The Town (part 2) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-16: Episode 24--The Town (part 2) - summary
The party split between the Silent Step Shrine and the Salty Sailor, where Baron LeFlay charmed Allyn and Garuet before warning them the governor had noticed them. Elanthan soldiers tried to break up the bread line, but Garuet's enlarged presence, Asher and Allyn's cantrips and Corwynn's appeal to shared service turned them away. The next day the party sold their bugbear gear to a smith for 323 gold, traded at Finston's curio shop and Uncommon Scents, and arranged forge and workshop time. LeFlay revealed himself as Coordinator of the Flares, Elric gave a failed sermon, and the Goliath Dandrick offered Garuet a link to hidden kin before vanishing into a shadow.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-30: Episode 25--The Village - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-30: Episode 25--The Village - summary
The party finished preparations in Pfilen, bought half-price cold weather gear at Wyatt's Leather Works, and set out for the Barriest Mountains. A suspicious Dandrick shadowed them and was accepted as a guide after Garuet confronted him. At the ruined village of Dickle they were ambushed by a regenerating zombie troll and four Harrowhounds and destroyed them. Dandrick reappeared afterward, and the session ended with a humming sound coming from the graveyard to the north.

chunks.title: Session 2026-08-13: Episode 26--The Village (part 2) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-08-13: Episode 26--The Village (part 2) - summary
The party scouted the ruined village of Dickle, sending Dandrick ahead while Muto and Allyn followed. They met a hunched old woman who proved to be an Annis Hag with Harrowhounds, a Harrowhawk and a giant zombie from the Sepulcher. Muto was knocked unconscious but revived by Corwynn. Allyn killed the hag, Garuet destroyed the zombie, and the party prepared to rest.

chunks.title: Session 2026-08-27: Episode 27--Tribes - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-08-27: Episode 27--Tribes - summary
After the graveyard battle, the party harvested the Annis Hag's remains and found her satchel, and Asher identified the Alchemical Compendium, Contingency Band, and Aged Goodberry Wine. Muto determined a rift had recently been active at Dickle. Dandrick guided them into the mountains, where Torchrunner Windborn found their camp and the party confronted both Goliaths about their history. Torchrunner led them to a hidden Goliath village, where Garuet pledged to restore her people to chief Felix Stonecrusher and the shamaness Berengar Stoneshaper, and Felix hinted at a request.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-10: Episode 28--A Simple Favor - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-10: Episode 28--A Simple Favor - summary
After waking at the Goliath village feeling stronger from leveling up, the party heard Chief Felix ask them to stop a predator killing the tribe's livestock. Muto identified a bulette, and Torchrunner led them to an alpine meadow where they ambushed it, only to face a second and a third. They killed two bulettes, one escaped underground, and they harvested armor plates, tremor sense glands and a rare animus. Torchrunner thanked them, the village feasted, and the party planned to head to the Alderwood and Vestalin the next morning.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-24: Episode 29--The Prophecy - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-24: Episode 29--The Prophecy - summary
Felix and Berengar gave Garuet an ancient hide bearing a prophecy of a leader who will unite the clans, and Berengar pledged his people to her cause. The party left the Hidden Dell with Torchrunner as guide and found a bridge destroyed by an oak troll. Corwynn's fireball burned off its shroud and Allyn killed it, and the party harvested its remains. After Torchrunner turned back near the Pass of Vestalin, they found the hidden cleft, where Muto detected two rifts deep underground.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-08: Episode 30--Labyrinth (part 1) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-08: Episode 30--Labyrinth (part 1) - summary
The party entered the Mines of Vestalin through the hidden cleft and descended a long spiral staircase to a vast cavern. Muto's ritual had shown two deep rifts, and they chose to head south toward the larger one. A Kruthik nest ambushed them, and after a hard fight they killed the swarm and the Kruthik Hive Lord, with Garuet's Branches of the Tree trapping the fleeing Hive Lord and Allyn striking the killing blow. They rested in Allyn's rope trick space, and learned Kruthiks are monstrosities, so Allyn's search for an aberration natural weapon must continue deeper.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - summary
After recapping the Kruthik ambush, the party harvested animus and parts and debated what to reserve for crafting. Asher and Muto's owl searched the Kruthik lair and found 20 chunks of gold-bearing ore. Allyn's scouting ahead found flaming skeletons and living flaming spheres, which the party destroyed in a fiery battle, and Asher judged them constructs guarding something undiscovered. A short rest and a detect portal spell led the group to a sickly cyan portal, where brain-beaked aberrations attacked and Muto's Dispel Magic failed to close it.
Cliffhanger: Muto is grappled and bitten for 22 by the large brain-beaked aberration, which now looms over Allyn on the ledge, while the cyan portal stays open after his failed dispel.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - Recap and Spoils
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - scene 1: Recap and Spoils
- Asher recapped the Kruthik ambush, the descent into the mine and the search for the Far Realm portal for Muto.
- Muto asked to charge his contingency ring, and the GM read out how it consumes potions, up to three.
- Garuet proposed swapping a common animus for an uncommon one, and Brother Elric chose the claws of the young Kruthiks.
- Asher argued that rare components should only be taken with a specific use in mind, since the party has no rare workshop yet.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - The Lair in the Column
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - scene 2: The Lair in the Column
- Muto's owl, seen through his eyes, rolled a 19 and spotted metallic glints in the lair's rock.
- After Asher climbed up, he found 20 chunks of gold-bearing ore, the largest the size of a softball.
- Allyn used his rope of climbing to reach a ledge 10 feet higher, and the rope knotted itself for everyone.
- From the ledge the party saw flickering light to the south.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - Fire and Bones
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - scene 3: Fire and Bones
- Allyn peeked around a corner and found a gaunt skeletal figure beside a five-foot ball of flame, which grew agitated and attacked.
- Brother Elric whiffed at first, then landed blows that bloodied a skeleton, since bludgeoning damage worked best on them.
- Muto hit the skeleton with Starry Wisp and later conjured spectral animals that shredded the spheres.
- Garuet raged and jumped in, and her axe passed through a fire image that proved to be mere flame.
- Corwynn's Turn Undead left a skeleton frightened and incapacitated, and the skeletons exploded in fire when they died.
- Asher's second-level chromatic orb killed the blue sphere, and Garuet cut another in half.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - Constructs and a Short Rest
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - scene 4: Constructs and a Short Rest
- Asher and Muto studied the remains; Asher's 22 Arcana check suggested the spheres were constructs from another plane, left as guardians.
- Corwynn healed Allyn for 18, Elric for 13 and Garuet for 11 on the short rest.
- The GM gave Brother Elric heroic inspiration for his well-prepared use of Lucky.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - The Cyan Portal
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - scene 5: The Cyan Portal
- Allyn found man-made walls and a 10-foot corridor to the south.
- Allyn saw a sickly cyan glow below the ledge and reported it to the party.
- The GM identified it as a portal, sturdier than a rift, which can be closed by damage or a powerful dispel.
- Muto's owl scout saw floating brain-like creatures, and one lashed out and killed it.
- Asher's Shatter and the party's attacks killed the blue and orange creatures.
- Muto's Dispel Magic failed to close the portal.
- A large aberration slammed Allyn prone, then grappled and bit Muto for 22.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-22: Guardians of Fire and the Cyan Portal - memorable quotes
- "I just saw the image of the Kruthik. Nom nom." - Muto (Dean)
- "It's a torch ball. That's what we're calling them." - Asher (Jim)
- "I'm not invisible anymore. Damn it." - Asher (Jim)
- "don't really do fire, so I'll pass." - Garuet (Steph)
- "He gets nibbled on by badgers." - Muto (Dean)
- "Asher refuses to have his brain picked because he doesn't like thinking about things that come from the far realm." - Asher (Jim)
- "terrible breach of our natural order here. Be gone." - Muto (Dean)

chunks.title: Carter Maine
chunks.text:
NPC: Carter Maine (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-05-07)
Also known as: Carter Main, Maine, Main, Carder Mane
Role: alchemist shop owner in Alderville; employer of Asher and Uton
Location: his shop in Alderville
Attitude to party: friendly; encouraged Asher to go with Muto
Status: alive
- (2025-08-14) Runs the alchemy shop that Muto enters, stocked with components, potions, scrolls and Anima storage bottles; he lives in the shop.
- (2025-08-14) Thanked Muto for the herbs and called him a good lad.
- (2025-08-14) Is working to find Asher lodging cheaper than the Mountain Inn and warned the Thief in Chain is a dive.
- (2025-08-14) Approved of Asher going with Muto to investigate the old homestead and gave Asher two Anima jars in case of anything interesting.
- (2025-08-14) Told Muto that Uton is not with them today and that he has tried many herbs without success to help him.
- (2025-11-06) Carder greeted Asher and Muto warmly and asked about their adventures in the Triskelion.
- (2025-11-06) Carder was impressed by the Cerberus skulls and the beautifully preserved Cerberus hide.
- (2025-11-06) Carder offered to buy the boggle hides at fifty gold pieces each.
- (2025-11-06) Carder retrieved old, heavy crafting books from a hidden, magically sealed cabinet and consulted them with Asher.
- (2025-11-20) Carder Mane identified the party's magical items for Asher, who lacked the spells to do so.
- (2025-11-20) Carder filled a pipe with pipeweed, lit it with a snap of his fingers and exhaled smoke shaped like a Mephet.

chunks.title: Carter Maine (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Carter Maine (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-05-07)
- (2025-11-20) Carder identified the Pipe of Smoke Monsters, two Potions of Comprehension, the Staff of Bird Calls, the Instrument of Illusions and the Lock of Trickery.
- (2026-01-01) Carder agreed to teach Asher Identify and Detect Magic in exchange for his time and help, and said Vestalin is dangerous but has useful herbs.
- (2026-01-01) Carder let Allyn use his workshop to enhance armor and asked Asher to supervise.
- (2026-01-01) Carder identified the unspelled staff as a staff of sleep, likely used by guards on prisoners.
- (2026-01-01) Carder offered to repair Asher's broken staff in exchange for the teaching, and Asher agreed.
- (2026-01-01) Carder confirmed the prosthetic leg is a finely crafted common magical item that works as a replacement limb.
- (2026-01-15) Carder Mane identified the creature as a skulk from the Shadowfell.
- (2026-01-15) Carder Mane crafted a charnel candle from grisly ingredients to reveal skulks and taught Asher the recipe.
- (2026-01-15) Carder Mane said skulks may convert victims or be used as assassins and can imitate their victims' lives.
- (2026-01-29) Carder Mane told Asher he and Uton were preparing fireworks, hangover cures and treats for Bright Night.
- (2026-01-29) Carder Mane assigned Asher the dangerous work of grinding sulfur and charcoal, collecting saltpeter from animal pens and helping make smoke powder.
- (2026-02-12) Ames Caelwyn told Asher he is an apprentice alchemist under Carder Mane.

chunks.title: Carter Maine (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Carter Maine (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-05-07)
- (2026-03-12) Carder Mane told Asher to never trust a noble except the Countess, whom he called nonpareil.
- (2026-03-12) Carder Mane warned against handling violet fungus directly while gathering materials like shrieker spores and violet fungus venom.
- (2026-03-12) Carder Mane offered to trade needed crafting materials for some of the party's darkling animus.
- (2026-03-26) Elric and Garuet collected two glowing fungus specimens believed to be on Carder Mane's requested materials list.
- (2026-04-23) Carder Mane was delighted by the rare fungi Asher delivered from the Underdark.
- (2026-04-23) Carder Mane and Uton assembled and launched the White Night fireworks display.
- (2026-04-23) Asher brewed a morning-after restorative potion for Carder Mane.
- (2026-05-07) Carder brewed strong coffee for Elric and put him to work grinding materials.
- (2026-05-07) Carder gave Ames an introductory lecture on alchemy.
- (2026-05-07) Carder told Muto most rifts can be closed by physical, magical, divine or primal force, but very old rifts are likely guarded on both sides and best approached with Verdina.
- (2026-05-07) Carder suggested Muto speak with Fordan the Ranger.
- (2026-05-07) Carder guided Asher in identifying the Drow scroll and potion.

chunks.title: Bob
chunks.text:
NPC: Bob (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-14)
Role: Alderville militiaman
Faction: Alderville militia
- (2025-08-14) Sent by a fellow militiaman to fetch the captain when the Red Hawks' trouble began; he ran off and returned with Captain Holcroft and Fred.

chunks.title: Fred
chunks.text:
NPC: Fred (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-14)
Role: Alderville militiaman
Faction: Alderville militia
- (2025-08-14) Militia guard who watched the camp with Bob and came with Captain Holcroft after the fight.

chunks.title: Red Hawk recruits
chunks.text:
NPC: Red Hawk recruits (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-07-30)
Also known as: Red Hawks, Red Hawk recruit, Redhawks, Redhawk mercenaries
Role: drunken mercenary recruits who harassed a refugee girl
Faction: Red Hawks
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: all five defeated or surrendered; carried off alive by their sergeant's group
- (2025-08-14) Five drunk new recruits in studded leather with a red hawk insignia, armed with maces, clubs and light crossbows, circled a terrified Filanese girl and refused Elric's and Corwynn's requests to stop.
- (2025-08-14) The party fought them nonlethally; they fought poorly because drunk (GM forgot disadvantage). One surrendered; none died.
- (2025-08-14) Muto searched and Allyn lifted about three silver pieces from an unconscious recruit, likely the rest of his recruitment bonus.
- (2026-06-04) The party recalled the Redhawks patrol the roads of Elantha hunting bandits and insurgents, traveling in subgroups.
- (2026-06-04) The party recalled an earlier encounter with Redhawk recruits being transported from Fort Beria north into Pfilen.
- (2026-06-04) Most of the party realized a Redhawk patrol might mistake them for bandits, so they agreed to leave the main road.
- (2026-07-02) In Jessain the Redhawks serve as the governor's enforcers and crack down on suspected disloyalty.
- (2026-07-30) The Redhawks act as troubleshooters for the occupation and are viewed by the party as troublemakers.

chunks.title: Red Hawk recruits (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Red Hawk recruits (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-07-30)
- (2026-07-30) The Redhawks were rumored to have investigated the ruined village of Dickle; Garuet found shod hoofprints there about a week to ten days old, consistent with a patrol.
- (2026-07-30) Horses are nearly impossible to acquire in Pfilen because the army and Redhawks are requisitioning all available animals.

chunks.title: Red Hawk sergeant
chunks.text:
NPC: Red Hawk sergeant (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-14)
Role: sergeant of the Red Hawks
Faction: Red Hawks
Attitude to party: hostile; stared intently and gave a two-finger salute
Status: alive
- (2025-08-14) A woman with sergeant stripes rode up with a regular army soldier, had the surviving recruit check his comrades, stared at the party, then rode off with the wounded draped over horses.

chunks.title: Filanese girl
chunks.text:
NPC: Filanese girl (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-14)
Role: refugee harassed by the Red Hawks
Faction: Filanese refugees
Attitude to party: admires Garuet
Status: alive
- (2025-08-14) Fainted from traumatic stress during the brawl; on waking she told Garuet she wished she could grow up big and strong like her, then ran into the crowd.

chunks.title: Mayor Woodson
chunks.text:
NPC: Mayor Woodson (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-05-07)
Also known as: Mayor Wood, Mayor Andricia Woodsdottor, Mayor Woodsdottor
Role: mayor of Alderville
Status: alive
- (2025-08-14) Wants to speak with the party; his daughter visited them in the tower after about an hour and advised keeping a low profile.
- (2025-11-06) Allyn overheard the Mayor being briefed by Captain Holcroft; she was surprised the party closed four rifts.
- (2025-11-06) The Mayor and Captain Holcroft agreed to keep a close eye on the party.
- (2025-11-06) The Mayor said the Morrigan would return with new recruits in a week or two.
- (2026-01-01) The Mayor has a gravelly voice from an old neck wound and showed exasperation at seeing the party.
- (2026-01-01) She advised the party to be polite and honest with the Countess, who has a sixth sense for people selling something.
- (2026-01-01) She looked alarmed when Asher said the new refugees had been press-ganged outside the Countess's lands, then sent for her secretary.
- (2026-01-01) The party concluded she feared repercussions from the King and viewed the refugees as potentially stolen property.
- (2026-03-12) Mayor Andricia Woodsdottor received Muto's sealed letter from the Countess and agreed to a militia escort, the wagon that brought the refugees and the refugees' own wagons for the resettlement.
- (2026-03-12) The Mayor said she could not post a permanent trooper at the homestead because of Bright Night, but would have riders pass by and inform Fordan to keep watch.
- (2026-05-07) The Mayor attended the duel.

chunks.title: Harpy
chunks.text:
NPC: Harpy (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-28)
Role: monster nesting in Muto's old homestead
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-14) Sang a charm song that charmed Corwynn, Asher, Elric and Garuet; Muto's Starry Wisp crit for 13 and she failed her concentration save (rolled 6 against DC 10) breaking it.
- (2025-08-14) Corwynn's Sacred Flame hit for 8; Garuet's thrown trident hit for 4 and toppled her; she clawed Garuet for 7 and Muto's staff killed her.
- (2025-08-14) Had been nesting in the house at night and outdoors by day, smashing the contents and leaving feathers, filth and half-eaten remains.
- (2025-08-28) The party piled the bodies from the harpy encounter and wrapped them respectfully in rugs before camping.

chunks.title: Vine blight
chunks.text:
NPC: Vine blight (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-14)
Also known as: Vine creature, Viney guy
Role: entangling plant creature at the homestead
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-14) Vines grabbed at the party; it created an entangle effect forcing a Constitution save, restraining Elric and Garuet.
- (2025-08-14) Elric harvested its bark.

chunks.title: Needle blights
chunks.text:
NPC: Needle blights (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-14)
Also known as: needle blight, twig blight
Role: spiky plant creatures at the homestead
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-14) Hurled needle-sized thorns, hitting Corwynn for 4 and Muto for 5; several more appeared around the house.
- (2025-08-14) Garuet critically hit one with a perfect crit and it exploded; Allyn and Elric killed others.

chunks.title: Captain Holcroft
chunks.text:
NPC: Captain Holcroft (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-05-21)
Also known as: Captain Sampson, Captain Samson, Captain Samson Holcroft
Role: captain of the Alderville militia
Faction: Alderville militia
Attitude to party: conditionally interested in Muto's plan
- (2025-08-14) Arrived after the brawl, thanked the party, said Mayor Woodson would like to speak to them, and hustled them into the tower to keep them out of sight.
- (2025-08-14) Reports to the mayor's daughter, who basically runs the militia.
- (2025-11-06) Captain Holcroft briefed the Mayor at the Mountain Inn on the party's closure of four rifts.
- (2025-11-06) Captain Holcroft discussed the Redhawks, the situation in Pfilen and upcoming noble visits.
- (2026-01-29) Captain Samson cut off a debrief about the Countess's journey when he noticed Muto and Garuet approaching.
- (2026-01-29) Captain Samson asked Muto for a list of prospective tenants and said he must consult the mayor and the Countess.
- (2026-01-29) Captain Samson acknowledged that moving refugees out of the camp would ease strain on the town.
- (2026-01-29) Muto, as a cat, overheard Captain Samson chewing out guardsmen for letting the Countess wander off during her journey.
- (2026-05-07) Captain Samson attended the duel at the lumber mill.
- (2026-05-21) Captain Samson Holcroft, whittling a flute, waved the party through to interview Ronan at the militia headquarters.
- (2026-05-21) Captain Samson asked for a new name for the Goliath.

chunks.title: Uton
chunks.text:
NPC: Uton (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-04-23)
Role: gnome
Location: Carter Maine's shop in Alderville
Status: alive
- (2025-08-14) Muto's father; he started working for Carter Maine, and stirred a cauldron of soup that he jarred for the refugee camp (about 24-32 quart jars).
- (2025-08-14) Has a home in town; his old homestead lies half a day's travel away in the Alderwood.
- (2025-11-06) Uton emerged from the back room unsteady and disoriented, said he had been working on something that could only be done in the dark of the moon, and went to the Mountain Inn to rest.
- (2025-11-06) When Muto whispered the name of the Fae they met, Uton said he remembered her and that Muto was lucky to meet one of the best among the Fae.
- (2025-11-06) Uton revealed he also made a deal in the Feywild that cost him dearly and warned Muto about the Fae.
- (2025-11-06) Uton fell into a fugue state for several minutes at the inn before snapping out of it.
- (2025-11-06) Uton revealed he traded twenty years of his life in the Feywild for the ability to combine uncommon animus with common components to create uncommon results.
- (2025-11-06) Uton demonstrated the technique with a jar of uncommon animus and told Muto to keep it secret, refusing to teach it to anyone else.
- (2026-01-01) Uton told Muto that Vestalin was a mining town of strategic importance to King Karlen, suggesting the gold mines were what the king wanted all along.
- (2026-01-01) Uton advised Muto to speak with the Countess about independent authority to protect the woods.

chunks.title: Uton (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Uton (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-04-23)
- (2026-01-01) Uton declined Muto's Goodberry, saying berries upset his stomach.
- (2026-01-29) Uton approved Muto's idea of settling refugee families at the homestead but said someone must provide security.
- (2026-01-29) Uton suggested Muto ask Captain Samson about road patrols.
- (2026-04-23) Asher helped Uton finish assembling shells and fuses for the White Night fireworks.

chunks.title: Uttan
chunks.text:
NPC: Uttan (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-14)
Also known as: Utahn
Location: Carter Maine's shop in Alderville
- (2025-08-14) Has spells of confusion, laughs and points at nothing, and says there are too many people in town and that he misses the old house.

chunks.title: Verdina Woodwise
chunks.text:
NPC: Verdina Woodwise (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2026-05-21) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Verdina
Role: Muto's mentor; druid and forest guardian
Attitude to party: grateful, friendly
Status: alive, rescued
Location: Alderwood
- (2025-08-28) Appeared as a healthy middle-aged woman with wild reddish hair and a green cloak, carrying a staff and wearing a peculiar amulet.
- (2025-08-28) Was found by the party sitting at their fire brewing tea and cooking goodberry tarts.
- (2025-08-28) Explained the Triskelion, a three-day period when all three moons go dark and rifts and portals open between planes.
- (2025-08-28) Performed a divination over an ewer of water showing four locations where rifts would likely appear.
- (2025-08-28) Explained that rifts can be closed by dealing enough damage or through a step-based process, both requiring touching range.
- (2025-08-28) Assigned the party the closer rifts while she handles the more dangerous distant ones.
- (2025-08-28) Appeared in Muto's dream lecturing him and saying she had hoped his training would have advanced more quickly.
- (2025-09-11) She is referenced as having briefed the party on closing the portals and where they would appear; she calls Muto 'mutton' as a term of endearment.
- (2025-10-09) A small bird landed on Muto's shoulder and spoke in her voice asking for help at the Ancient Plinth Altar, surrounded by gnolls.
- (2025-10-09) She gave the party until midnight and asked them to avenge her if they failed.

chunks.title: Verdina Woodwise (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Verdina Woodwise (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2026-05-21) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-10-23) Was found unconscious and badly injured at the base of the plinth, held captive by gnolls.
- (2025-10-23) Muto revived her with Healing Word.
- (2025-10-23) Explained the gnolls needed her blood to reopen the infernal rift.
- (2025-10-23) Said she had closed both elemental rifts and was saving this one for last.
- (2025-10-23) Drank the bowl of her own blood, saying it was necessary, and threw the bowl into the fire.
- (2025-10-23) Told the party they can call her name if they need help in the woods.
- (2025-10-23) Departed by stepping around a red bark tree and vanishing.
- (2026-01-01) The Countess told Muto to consult Verdina, who knows her mind.
- (2026-01-29) Verdina ran Muto ragged through the woods, tested his new abilities and advised him how to use them.
- (2026-04-23) Muto wants to consult Verdina about the long-standing magical rifts.
- (2026-05-21) Muto found Verdina in the drizzly Alderwood; a natural 20 through his owl's eyes let him spot her behind him.
- (2026-05-21) Verdina declined Muto's goodberry and suggested he toss it to his owl.
- (2026-05-21) Verdina said rifts in the Alderwood are short-lived because they are hunted and closed, while beyond the Countess's lands some profit from keeping them open.
- (2026-05-21) Verdina described the evil of Vestalin as rooted in greed and a curse binding the miners who collapsed their tunnels.

chunks.title: Verdina Woodwise (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Verdina Woodwise (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2026-05-21) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-21) Verdina pointed Muto to the mountains for displacer beasts and to rifts for elementals and fiends, and warned against relying on man-made crutches.
- (2026-05-21) Verdina vanished around a tree without reappearing.

chunks.title: Darklings
chunks.text:
NPC: Darklings (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2025-08-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: darkling
Role: Fae creatures cursed by the Summer Queen that came through the first rift
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-28) Four cloaked darklings with two-toed feet and daggers emerged from the glowing rift at the ancient tree and looked surprised to see the party.
- (2025-08-28) They did not understand Garuet's Common warning to go home or die and attacked; some daggers dealt necrotic damage as well as piercing.
- (2025-08-28) Brother Elric was dropped to 0 hit points by a darkling and revived by Muto's Healing Word.
- (2025-08-28) Each darkling exploded in a death flash on dying, which can blind nearby creatures; Elric was blinded.
- (2025-08-28) Garuet killed the remaining darklings with a cleaving great axe strike.
- (2025-08-28) Asher's study revealed they have blindsight, devil's sight, light sensitivity and the death flash.

chunks.title: Dust mephits
chunks.text:
NPC: Dust mephits (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2025-08-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: dust mephit
Role: spindly winged elemental creatures from a rift
Location: Marshy Forest Crossing
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-28) Hid in trees and dead branches near the fallen tree until Allyn spotted them, then attacked with blinding breath and sleep spells.
- (2025-08-28) Asher's study found they are immune to poison and exhaustion, explode when killed, and some can cast spells.
- (2025-08-28) Garuet's thrown trident hit one for 10 and knocked it prone; Muto's Starry Wisp then killed it for 10, causing it to explode.
- (2025-08-28) They speak Primordial.

chunks.title: Mud mephits
chunks.text:
NPC: Mud mephits (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2025-08-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: mud mephit
Role: elemental creatures from a rift, sturdier than dust mephits
Location: Marshy Forest Crossing
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-08-28) Sprayed mud in cones that restrained Elric and others; Corwynn resisted using heroic inspiration.
- (2025-08-28) One attempted to cast sleep on Muto, who saved.
- (2025-08-28) They explode when killed; all six mephits in total were defeated by the party.

chunks.title: Thea
chunks.text:
NPC: Thea (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: waitress at the Salty Sailor
Status: alive
Location: The Salty Sailor, Jessain
Attitude to party: happy but worried to see Allyn
- (2025-08-28) Appeared in Allyn's dream dealing cards and warned that his nature has served him well enough but he should not begin to serve it.
- (2026-06-04) Thea was noted as Allyn's sister, last heard to be in the town of Josain.
- (2026-06-18) Allyn named finding his sister Thea in Jessain as his first priority.
- (2026-07-02) Allyn and Garuet found Thea working at the Salty Sailor inn in Jessain.
- (2026-07-02) Allyn gave Thea some money and a magically created bouquet of flowers.
- (2026-07-02) Thea nervously told Allyn someone in a back room wished to speak with him.
- (2026-07-02) Thea quickly replaced a questionable drink Trish served Garuet.
- (2026-07-02) Thea seems to be under the protection of Hovan Garth.
- (2026-07-16) Allyn asked Baron LeFlay to ensure Thea's safety as a personal favor, and LeFlay agreed.

chunks.title: King Karlen
chunks.text:
NPC: King Karlen (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2026-01-01) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: King Karlen Elanian
Role: King of Elantha
- (2025-08-28) Sat at the card table on Allyn's right in Allyn's dream.
- (2026-01-01) The Countess described King Karlen as bold, brash and foolish, whose legacy is war and blood.

chunks.title: Baron LeFlay
chunks.text:
NPC: Baron LeFlay (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Baron LeFley, Baron LaFlay, Baron Anton LeFlay, Anton LeFlay
Role: Coordinator of the Flares, an insurgent organization
Location: The Salty Sailor, Jessain
Status: alive
Attitude to party: warm, jovial, pragmatic
- (2025-08-28) Sat at the card table on Allyn's left in Allyn's dream.
- (2025-11-06) Baron LeFlay's facilitator Hovan Garth tasked Allyn with disrupting press gang caravans.
- (2025-12-18) Allyn reminded the party of his obligation to Baron LeFlay to disrupt the slavers.
- (2026-01-01) The Countess warned Allyn the Baron presents an affable appearance but is capable of extreme actions.
- (2026-01-01) The party judged the two caravans they hit were likely the ones Hovan Garth targeted for Allyn.
- (2026-05-21) Allyn asked the Countess about Baron LeFlay; she confirmed Pfilen nobles' titles were revoked but land holdings generally remained.
- (2026-07-02) Baron Anton LeFlay met Allyn and Garuet in a private room at the Salty Sailor, already aware of the party's activities.
- (2026-07-02) Baron LeFlay said his days of being a baron appear over but his days of wielding power in Pfilen have not ended.
- (2026-07-02) Baron LeFlay greeted Garuet in Golka and said he spent a season hunting with her Goliath clan, the Gar-Daingalyska, many years ago.
- (2026-07-02) Baron LeFlay stated his intention to conspire with Allyn about the future of Pfilen.

chunks.title: Baron LeFlay (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Baron LeFlay (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-07-16) Baron LeFlay told Allyn and Garuet a ribald anecdote about spending a season with Garuet's tribe as a young man, being gored by a dire bison and nursed by a lovely woman.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay said the king seized his barony after the war, so he is now merely Anton LeFlay, traveling between Loughburg and Jessain to tend to interests not entirely above board.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay sent Allyn and Garuet back to the shrine because the governor had noticed their efforts.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay revealed to the party that he is the Coordinator of the Flares, an insurgent group built from the remnants of his power.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay said hunger breeds the anger needed for revolution, and that the people's suffering is the kindling for the fire he intends to light.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay acknowledged the party's sale of weapons to his contacts as a contribution to the coming reckoning.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay revealed that Fordan the Ranger and Asher's mentor are associates of his and warned the party to ensure their safety.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay said the cage wagons would be ideal for smuggling people or materials into Vestalin.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay described Vestalin as a pit of despair and greed and said he is working to prevent General August from achieving his goals there.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay gave his word to Allyn that he would ensure Thea's safety.

chunks.title: Baron LeFlay (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Baron LeFlay (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay offered the party his influence while they remain in Pfilen but refused to share operational details for security reasons.

chunks.title: The Abbess
names: abbess of the Monastery of the Silent Step
chunks.text:
NPC: The Abbess (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2025-08-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: abbess of the Monastery of the Silent Step
Role: leader of the Monastery of the Silent Step
Faction: Monastery of the Silent Step
- (2025-08-28) Her voice appeared in Elric's dream telling him his brotherhood can only take him so far and to look to his new family.

chunks.title: Goblin spellcaster
chunks.text:
NPC: Goblin spellcaster (first seen 2025-09-11, last seen 2025-09-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: robed goblin, goblin caster, goblin mage
Role: robed goblin magic-user performing a ritual to make the Feywild rift permanent
Faction: goblins
Location: Feywild rift site, Alderwood
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-09-11) He was performing a ritual to upgrade the rift into a portal.
- (2025-09-11) Allyn marked him with Hunter's Mark and hit him with a crossbow bolt when he stepped out from behind cover, disrupting the ritual.
- (2025-09-11) Asher hit him with magic missile for 10 total damage.
- (2025-09-11) He cast a spell that knocked Garuet prone and dizzy.
- (2025-09-11) He teleported two goblins to flank his position and shouted warnings about humans.
- (2025-09-11) He tried to make Elric dizzy and to poison Garuet, but both saved.
- (2025-09-11) He took total cover behind the stone table between casts.
- (2025-09-11) Muto slid across the stone table and killed him with a finishing blow.

chunks.title: Goblin raiders
chunks.text:
NPC: Goblin raiders (first seen 2025-09-11, last seen 2025-09-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: goblin archers, goblin warriors, goblins, purple goblin, orange goblin, blue goblin, yellow goblin
Role: goblin archers and melee fighters guarding the ritual
Faction: goblins
Location: Feywild rift site, Alderwood
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-09-11) Four goblins of different colors accompanied the spellcaster, and hidden archers fired from the bluffs.
- (2025-09-11) Brother Elric recognized their language as goblin from his military experience.
- (2025-09-11) Garuet killed a purple goblin with a critical glaive strike through the standing stones.
- (2025-09-11) Corwynn killed the yellow goblin with Sacred Flame.
- (2025-09-11) Brother Elric punched a goblin to death.
- (2025-09-11) Goblin archers downed Muto and Asher; one shouted 'kill healer!' in goblin.
- (2025-09-11) A blue goblin critically hit Garuet with a dagger and knocked her unconscious.
- (2025-09-11) Garuet killed the last goblin and all were defeated.

chunks.title: Lumpy fiendish creatures
chunks.text:
NPC: Lumpy fiendish creatures (first seen 2025-09-25, last seen 2025-09-25) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: oompa loompas, Oompa Loompa creatures
Role: small fiendish guardians moving around the standing stones
Location: Forest Clearing with Standing Stones, Alderwood
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-09-25) Four small lumpy fiendish creatures shambled around the standing stones and gave off a rotting, slaughterhouse-like stench.
- (2025-09-25) One exuded a noxious cloud from its pores that poisoned Brother Elric and Garuet.
- (2025-09-25) Allyn's crossbow shot made one explode in a shower of corruption.
- (2025-09-25) Garuet's axe cleaved one, which deflated like a bag of foul-smelling air.
- (2025-09-25) Allyn killed another with his crossbow and it faded away.

chunks.title: Cackling fiendish creatures
chunks.text:
NPC: Cackling fiendish creatures (first seen 2025-09-25, last seen 2025-09-25) [unconfirmed record]
Role: jagged fiendish spellcasters whose harsh laughter caused unease
Location: Forest Clearing with Standing Stones, Alderwood
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-09-25) Two jagged fiendish creatures were the source of the harsh, guttural laughter.
- (2025-09-25) One hurled a firebolt at Muto for 7 fire damage, cast at disadvantage because Muto had cover.
- (2025-09-25) Another tried to assault Muto's mind with weird laughing sounds, but Muto resisted with an 18 Wisdom save.

chunks.title: Fiendish Cerberus
chunks.text:
NPC: Fiendish Cerberus (first seen 2025-10-09, last seen 2025-10-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: three-headed fiendish creature
Role: three-headed fiendish beast that clawed through the first rift
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-10-09) It emerged from the rift just as the party thought they had closed it and howled to frighten them.
- (2025-10-09) Its left head's howl forced Constitution saves, and Muto failed and became frightened.
- (2025-10-09) Its center head bit Muto for 12 slashing and 1 fire damage, leaving him at 5 hit points.
- (2025-10-09) It pounced on Brother Elric for 11 slashing damage, and Brother Elric saved against being knocked prone.
- (2025-10-09) Its fiery blood ignited the ground when Brother Elric hit it with his quarterstaff.
- (2025-10-09) It saved against Muto's Entangle and leaped out of the entanglement.
- (2025-10-09) Corwynn's Guiding Bolt dealt 14 radiant damage to it.
- (2025-10-09) Garuet's cleave struck the rift and closed it, cutting the creature off from its home plane.
- (2025-10-09) Allyn delivered the killing blow.

chunks.title: Cackler demons
chunks.text:
NPC: Cackler demons (first seen 2025-10-09, last seen 2025-10-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: cacklers
Role: spiky demons guarding the first rift
Status: dead
- (2025-10-09) Muto examined them and learned they are common rarity with resistances to cold, fire, lightning and nonmagical weapon damage and immunity to poison.

chunks.title: Dretch demons
chunks.text:
NPC: Dretch demons (first seen 2025-10-09, last seen 2025-10-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: dretches
Role: low-level fiendish creatures from the first rift
Status: dead
- (2025-10-09) Brother Elric studied them and learned they are low-level fiendish creatures.

chunks.title: Boggles
chunks.text:
NPC: Boggles (first seen 2025-10-09, last seen 2025-10-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: boggle, red boggle
Role: slippery fey ambushers who teleport and leave sticky goo
Faction: Feywild creatures at the marsh rift site
Location: Marshy hillock with standing stones
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: three killed, one escaped into the marsh
- (2025-10-09) Muto tried to speak to them in Sylvan, but they turned hostile and said the party might be good to eat.
- (2025-10-09) They teleported around the battlefield and attacked Asher, Muto, Garuet and Brother Elric.
- (2025-10-09) Allyn killed one with his short sword.
- (2025-10-09) Muto killed one with Shillelagh and it sank into the water.
- (2025-10-09) Garuet killed one with her glaive.
- (2025-10-09) Allyn killed another, which burst in black goo.
- (2025-10-09) Their grapple attempts on Brother Elric and Asher failed.
- (2025-10-09) One boggle escaped into the marsh.

chunks.title: Nilbogs
chunks.text:
NPC: Nilbogs (first seen 2025-10-09, last seen 2025-10-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: nilbog
Role: goblins possessed by shards of an ancient goblin trickster god, trying to force open a rift
Faction: goblins
Location: Marshy hillock with standing stones
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-10-09) They used psychic attacks, charm and Tasha's hideous laughter against the party.
- (2025-10-09) Brother Elric and Muto were charmed and praised the nilbogs instead of attacking.
- (2025-10-09) Allyn resisted one charm but was later felled by hideous laughter.
- (2025-10-09) Garuet resisted a laughter effect because she was raging.
- (2025-10-09) One nilbog healed itself automatically, negating Corwynn's Sacred Flame and part of Allyn's stab.
- (2025-10-09) Garuet's thrown trident killed the final nilbog.
- (2025-10-09) Asher learned with an arcana check that nilbogs are spirits of goblin trickster gods possessing goblins.
- (2025-10-09) One nilbog shouted 'Open, damn you, open!' while trying to force something open.

chunks.title: Grinning Cat
chunks.text:
NPC: Grinning Cat (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: fae predator and adjudicator of fey duels
Faction: Feywild, serves a queen
Location: Feywild
Attitude to party: friendly, impressed
Status: alive
- (2025-10-23) Appeared as adjudicator of the duel and spoke in Elvish and Common.
- (2025-10-23) Offered help in exchange for a worthy gift; Garuet gave her the Cerberus heart, which she devoured with delight.
- (2025-10-23) Revealed that Muto's father had stayed with her queen and forgot much of it.
- (2025-10-23) Warned about bargaining without knowledge in the fae realm.
- (2025-10-23) Led the party through the Feywild to a second portal but declined to go further.
- (2025-10-23) Performed a farewell ritual and gave the party her calling names Shalali and Happy Claws.

chunks.title: Fairy dragon
chunks.text:
NPC: Fairy dragon (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: pseudo-dragon
Role: fae duelist and time-magic user
Location: Feywild
Attitude to party: helpful
Status: alive
- (2025-10-23) Won an honor duel against a darkling elder and pinned it beneath its claws.
- (2025-10-23) Offered to suspend time so the party could take a long rest without losing time before the midnight deadline.

chunks.title: Darkling elder
chunks.text:
NPC: Darkling elder (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: fae duelist
Location: Feywild
Status: alive, defeated
- (2025-10-23) Cast darkness over the clearing during the honor duel.
- (2025-10-23) Lost the duel and was transformed into an eel-like form, pinned by the fairy dragon.

chunks.title: Gnoll commander
chunks.text:
NPC: Gnoll commander (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: leader of the gnolls holding Verdina
Faction: gnolls
Location: Ancient Plinth Altar
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-10-23) Took position on a fallen pillar and barked orders to the gnolls and hyenas.
- (2025-10-23) Attacked with infernal fire-burning weapons and dealt grievous wounds to Allyn.
- (2025-10-23) Carried gold nuggets and a healing potion.

chunks.title: Gnolls
chunks.text:
NPC: Gnolls (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: gnoll guards
Role: captors performing a blood ritual to reopen an infernal rift
Faction: gnoll pack
Location: Ancient Plinth Altar
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-10-23) Had captured Verdina and were harvesting her blood to reopen the infernal rift.
- (2025-10-23) Were waiting for reinforcements to return.
- (2025-10-23) Alerted by a twig snap, they fought the party with hyenas; all were killed.
- (2025-10-23) All of them saved against Muto's Entangle.

chunks.title: Hyenas
chunks.text:
NPC: Hyenas (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: fiendish hunting animals of the gnolls
Faction: gnoll pack
Location: Ancient Plinth Altar
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-10-23) Emerged from bushes and surrounded the party, biting Allyn.
- (2025-10-23) Allyn killed one with his sword.

chunks.title: Fordan
chunks.text:
NPC: Fordan (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Forden
Role: ranger
Location: Alderwood
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
Faction: the Flares
- (2025-10-23) Met the party on a hilltop with his three sons.
- (2025-10-23) Reported that he and his sons killed gnolls on the road.
- (2025-10-23) Delivered the Mayor's message that it is safe for the party to return to town.
- (2025-10-23) The party warned him of possible remaining gnolls at the Plinth Altar.
- (2025-11-06) Fordan and three of his sons were met in the woods before the party returned; they were dealing with rift stragglers and confirmed it was safe to return.
- (2026-03-12) Fordan emerged from the treeline with a freshly killed buck and provided a venison feast for the new settlers on their first night at the homestead.
- (2026-05-07) Fordan attended the duel with his sons.
- (2026-05-07) Carder suggested Muto consult Fordan about dangerous creatures and rifts in the Alderwood.
- (2026-07-16) Baron LeFlay revealed that Fordan the Ranger is an associate of his and a contact for reaching the resistance from the south.

chunks.title: Horton, Norton, and Morton
chunks.text:
NPC: Horton, Norton, and Morton (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2026-01-15) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Fordan's sons, Horton
Role: Fordan's sons and forest guards
Location: Alderwood
Status: alive
- (2025-10-23) Accompanied Fordan on patrol, wearing light armor with the Aldervale symbol.
- (2026-01-15) Horton, a militia guard and son of Fordan, watched Garuet and Allyn at the camp.
- (2026-01-15) Horton told them people had gone missing after Triskelion, which is unusual, and showed off gnoll ears the Countess pays for.

chunks.title: Mira Cragshield
chunks.text:
NPC: Mira Cragshield (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-11-20) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Mira
Role: smith and craftsperson
Location: Mira Cragshield's Forge
Attitude to party: warm
- (2025-10-23) Muto mentioned her foundry as a possible crafting workshop alongside Carter Maine's shop.
- (2025-11-06) Mira admired the Cerberus skull Garuet carried and said she would like to buy one if Garuet sold.
- (2025-11-06) Mira had no work to offer Garuet for credits.
- (2025-11-06) Mira said her shop lacks the ambiance to craft with such rare materials and that a rare forge would be needed.
- (2025-11-06) Mira recalled rumors of a rare forge in the mines of Vestalin.
- (2025-11-06) Mira told Garuet she had not seen other goliaths, though some refugees had passed through.
- (2025-11-20) Mira sold Garuet a suit of scale mail for 50 gold.
- (2025-11-20) Mira sent Garuet a note when the armor was ready and fitted it to her perfectly after a couple of days.

chunks.title: Nelson
chunks.text:
NPC: Nelson (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-01-29) [unconfirmed record]
Role: off-duty militiaman
Location: Aldervale gate
- (2025-11-06) Nelson greeted the party at the gate and told them some of them had mail waiting at the Militia Barracks.
- (2026-01-29) Nelson told of finding a cave in the Berius mountains believed to lead to the Underdark while trailing Duergar who raided a lumber camp.
- (2026-01-29) Nelson said he will be transferred to the Capitol after Bright Night to guard the Countess on her return.

chunks.title: Anson
chunks.text:
NPC: Anson (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-05-07) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Aldervale militia member
Location: Aldervale
Status: alive, wounded
- (2025-11-06) Anson confirmed that Corwynn and Brother Elric had received letters and retrieved both envelopes.
- (2026-01-15) Anson was struck from behind by a third skulk and healed by Garuet's Healing Word.
- (2026-01-15) Anson praised Corwynn's spectacular Guiding Bolt.
- (2026-01-29) Anson discussed the Underdark cave and the Duergar with Nelson at the Thief and Chain.
- (2026-02-12) Anson and another militiaman on patrol took Allyn's report of a possible skulk in the woods seriously and searched the trees with the party.
- (2026-05-07) Anson witnessed the duel challenge and was told to inform Captain Samson and enjoy the show.

chunks.title: Enzo
chunks.text:
NPC: Enzo (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2025-11-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: former miner and old acquaintance of Garuet from Pfilen
Faction: Pfilenese refugees
- (2025-11-06) Enzo sent Garuet a crude note via a child in the refugee camp.

chunks.title: Hovan Garth
chunks.text:
NPC: Hovan Garth (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: intermediary and security for Baron LeFlay
Faction: Baron LeFlay
Location: Jessain
Attitude to party: menacing, few words
- (2025-11-06) Hovan Garth met Allyn and Garuet at the Thief in Chain at sundown and extended Allyn's deadline by a month.
- (2025-11-06) Hovan tasked Allyn with disrupting a press gang caravan collecting miners for General Augustus at Vestalin.
- (2025-11-06) Hovan said the Baron has schedules of these deliveries and that disruption could lead to a meeting with Countess Hargan.
- (2025-11-06) Hovan gave Allyn a quick map of the route, said two caravans would converge in one week on the ninth of Life, and torched the map.
- (2025-11-06) Hovan declined to give Allyn money for provisions.
- (2025-11-06) Hovan said with a leer that Allyn's sister sent her best wishes.
- (2026-05-07) Allyn recalled a card game involving Hovan Garth and realized in hindsight that he had been set up.
- (2026-07-02) Hovan Garth was present at the meeting with Baron LeFlay, cleaning his nails with a wicked-looking knife.
- (2026-07-02) Hovan Garth's weapons were not peace-bonded, showing disregard for the occupiers' rules.
- (2026-07-16) Hovan Garth received a whispered message and passed it to LeFlay warning that the governor had noticed the party.
- (2026-07-16) Hovan Garth waited at the shrine with a summons from LeFlay and escorted the party to the private back room.

chunks.title: General Augustus
chunks.text:
NPC: General Augustus (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: General August
Role: general collecting miners for his posting at Vestalin via press gangs
Location: Vestalin
- (2025-11-06) GMAssistant notes he led the siege of Vestalin and was later sentenced to restore it and reopen its mines.
- (2025-12-04) The letter named General August in Vestalin as the one to pay for delivered prisoners.
- (2026-05-21) The Countess said General Augustus was under mounting crown pressure to restore gold from Vestalin.
- (2026-05-21) Verdina said General Augustus had been unable to force entry into the mines and commended the party for reducing his capabilities.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay said he is working to prevent General August from achieving his goals in Vestalin.

chunks.title: Countess Hargan
chunks.text:
NPC: Countess Hargan (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Countess governing the Alderwood and Aldervale
Attitude to party: protective
Location: Countess's Estate
- (2025-11-06) She issued a county decree declaring a free travel zone and opposing coercion and impeding travel.
- (2025-11-06) The party suspected the decree is a subtle stand against the King's press gangs.
- (2025-11-06) She is expected to visit Aldervale around the sixteenth of Life for Bright Night.
- (2025-12-04) The letter said she harbors many Pfilenese and threatened reprisals against anyone impressing them on her lands.
- (2026-01-01) The Countess, an older woman with long silvery hair, hosted the party for tea and showed detailed knowledge of each member's background and deeds.
- (2026-01-01) Garuet greeted her in Golka and the Countess replied in kind.
- (2026-01-01) On hearing the ogres killed one slaver group and the party killed the ogres, she laughed and said she knew she had chosen well, then declared the matter closed.
- (2026-01-01) She read the King's Writ and warned the party to tell no one, calling it the equivalent of a keg of blasting powder.
- (2026-01-01) She promised to help the refugees within the limits of Karlen's law and asked Asher to prepare hangover remedies before White Night.
- (2026-01-01) She told Muto to consult Verdina about protecting the Alderwood.
- (2026-01-01) She warned Allyn that Baron LeFlay is dangerous with wide reach and called her relationship with him complicated.

chunks.title: Countess Hargan (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Countess Hargan (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-01-01) She criticized King Karlen as bold, brash and foolish, and told Garuet she saw great things in her and would introduce her to someone soon.
- (2026-01-01) She chatted with Corwynn about the capital and his brother's upcoming marriage, staring intently at his face.
- (2026-01-15) The Countess asked the party to check back with her before White Night and had warned them the writ is like a keg of blasting powder.
- (2026-01-29) Countess Hargan returned to Aldervale with a caravan, tossing treat packets to the crowd and giving a speech at her estate.
- (2026-01-29) She announced a deputation of nobles would arrive the next day to observe the refugee situation and urged her people to behave.
- (2026-01-29) She pointed out the party in the crowd as heroes.
- (2026-01-29) Overheard talk said she slipped away from her caravan into the woods in only a day gown for a full day, matching the day she interviewed the party.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess used the Message spell to whisper a lunch invitation into Muto's ear, requesting that everyone attend.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess told Elric she knows he is Eldran Caelwyn, a supposedly deceased noble scion, saying it is her role to know all that goes on in her town.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess said she invited Ames Caelwyn to Aldervale to try to draw him away from less savory noble factions.

chunks.title: Countess Hargan (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Countess Hargan (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-03-12) The Countess agreed to speak to the mayor about Elric's proposal to establish a small presence of monks of the Silent Step in Aldervale.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess warned the party that poking at Baron Jorand and his people drew his dangerous curiosity, and urged them to leave town until Bright Night Eve.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess gave Garuet her solemn word, on her station and house, to do everything she can to see Garuet and her clan receive justice, with a part for Garuet to play.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess warned that hunting a dragon alone is folly, using it as a metaphor for Baron Jorand.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess said Baron Jorand moved his seat closer to Vestalin to leverage the mines there.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess wrote a sealed letter to Mayor Andricia for Muto, directing her to furnish the means to resettle refugees at Muto's family estate.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess served each party member their favorite dish at lunch.
- (2026-04-23) The Countess sent a letter addressed to 'Muto and Associates' warning the party to stay in the village because she was hosting a masked ball for the visiting nobility.
- (2026-04-23) The Countess sent a wagon of food and ale across the bridge to the refugee camp during White Night.
- (2026-05-07) The GM explained the Countess sent her letter keeping the party away from the gala because of their earlier meeting with the visiting nobles.

chunks.title: Countess Hargan (part 4)
chunks.text:
NPC: Countess Hargan (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-21) The Countess praised Garuet for the duel and called Ronan a loose end House Jorund would not leave dangling.
- (2026-05-21) The Countess pledged her influence to keep Tarvhik safe within the city walls after Garuet vowed to protect him.
- (2026-05-21) The Countess offered property and material support for a priory of Elric's order in Aldervale.
- (2026-05-21) The Countess said Baron Elias Jorund was furious over his missing press gangs and General Augustus was pressed by the crown to restore gold from Vestalin.
- (2026-05-21) The Countess warned the party to approach Vestalin covertly and carefully, and said gathering information was a task suited to them.
- (2026-06-04) The party discussed that the Countess protects her people from press gangs and has the pull to enforce her will in ways lesser houses like Caelwyn cannot.

chunks.title: The Morrigan
chunks.text:
NPC: The Morrigan (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2025-11-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: figure associated with the Red Hawks
Faction: Red Hawks
- (2025-11-06) The Morrigan is expected to return with new recruits in a week or two.

chunks.title: House Vira
chunks.text:
NPC: House Vira (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2025-11-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: minor noble family from the capital
Location: the capital
- (2025-11-06) Corwynn recognized House Vira's seal on the ornate letter addressed to Brother Elric.

chunks.title: Giant spiders
chunks.text:
NPC: Giant spiders (first seen 2025-11-20, last seen 2025-11-20) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: giant spider, blue giant spider
Role: ambush predators
Location: misty clearing in the woods, above a chasm
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: one dead by sword, one killed by Brother Elric, one wounded and retreated into the chasm
- (2025-11-20) A huge giant spider sat at the center of the web over the chasm; Allyn hit it with his crossbow and Dreadful Strike and it retreated into the chasm.
