- (2025-11-20) A second giant spider dropped from a tree and webbed at Garuet, who dodged it; Corwynn burned it with fiery rays and Allyn killed it by stabbing its unwounded eye.
- (2025-11-20) The blue giant spider bit Garuet and was killed by Brother Elric's critical unarmed strike.
- (2025-11-20) Asher identified the spiders as beasts vulnerable to fire.

chunks.title: Murray
chunks.text:
NPC: Murray (first seen 2025-11-20, last seen 2025-11-20) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: phase spider
Role: phase spider
Location: misty clearing in the woods
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-11-20) The ethereal phase spider webbed and restrained Garuet, and missed Allyn with two bites.
- (2025-11-20) It bit Corwynn twice with potent venom and missed Brother Elric.
- (2025-11-20) Allyn's bolt and Asher's Magic Missile bloodied it and Brother Elric killed it with his quarterstaff.
- (2025-11-20) Some of the party recognized it as Murray, a legendary recurring foe from an earlier campaign.

chunks.title: Dying Red Hawk mercenary
chunks.text:
NPC: Dying Red Hawk mercenary (first seen 2025-11-20, last seen 2025-12-04) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: dying mercenary
Role: former Red Hawks mercenary
Faction: Red Hawks
Location: scene of carnage
Status: dead
- (2025-11-20) He was found hiding under a bush, wearing studded leather, with his chest caved in by something huge.
- (2025-11-20) Corwynn judged he could not be saved even with healing.
- (2025-11-20) He said 'You, what are you doing here...? Wait, you're not her. You're...' to Corwynn and died.
- (2025-11-20) The party concluded he had mistaken Corwynn for someone else.
- (2025-11-20) A discolored hawk-shaped patch with red enamel remnants on his armor marked him as a former Red Hawk.
- (2025-12-04) The party found him wounded and hiding in bushes near the overturned wagon, wearing Red Hawk armor with its emblem torn away.
- (2025-12-04) He died of his injuries and shock shortly after the party found him.
- (2025-12-04) Corwynn's presence seemed to trigger a final reaction from him.

chunks.title: Groundhog
chunks.text:
NPC: Groundhog (first seen 2025-12-04, last seen 2025-12-04) [unconfirmed record]
Role: eyewitness to the wagon attack
Location: burrow in a bluff near the scene of carnage
Attitude to party: cooperative, timid
- (2025-12-04) Muto cast Speak with Animals and coaxed the groundhog out of its lair with a treat.
- (2025-12-04) The groundhog described two enormous man-shaped attackers, one with a club and one hurling rocks.
- (2025-12-04) It said they flipped the supply wagon, killed the draft animals and took the second wagon full of prisoners.
- (2025-12-04) It pointed out the direction the wagon went and where the wounded man crawled into the brush.

chunks.title: Ogres
chunks.text:
NPC: Ogres (first seen 2025-12-04, last seen 2025-12-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: ogre
Role: attackers who captured the prisoner wagon
Location: cave behind the waterfall
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-12-04) Two ogres, eight or nine feet tall, ambushed the wagons and held the prisoners in the cave.
- (2025-12-04) One ogre threw a javelin that pierced Garuet's thigh.
- (2025-12-04) Garuet killed the first ogre by thrusting her glaive up under its chin.
- (2025-12-04) The second ogre entered from outside and fell to Muto's Moonbeam, Corwynn's Sacred Flame and Brother Elric's final unarmed strike.
- (2025-12-04) The party studied the corpses and learned ogres have Strength 19 and Intelligence 5.
- (2025-12-18) The party decided to drag the ogre corpses outside near the waterfall and burn them.

chunks.title: Worgs
chunks.text:
NPC: Worgs (first seen 2025-12-04, last seen 2025-12-04) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: worg
Role: cave guards
Location: ogre cave
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-12-04) Two worgs chained to a ledge barked when the party entered the cave.
- (2025-12-04) Garuet leaped onto the ledge and attacked them with her greataxe.
- (2025-12-04) Allyn killed the first worg with his scimitar and Muto killed the other with Starry Wisp.
- (2025-12-04) Asher identified the worgs as fey creatures from the Feywild.

chunks.title: Freed Pfilenese prisoners
chunks.text:
NPC: Freed Pfilenese prisoners (first seen 2025-12-04, last seen 2026-01-01) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: eight prisoners, dwarf prisoner, elf prisoner
Role: captured miners and families
Location: Pfilenese refugee camp
Attitude to party: grateful
Status: alive, freed
- (2025-12-04) Eight prisoners, including a dwarf, an elf and several humans with women and children, were freed from the wagon after Allyn picked the padlock.
- (2025-12-04) They had been in the wagon nearly two weeks and were captured that morning.
- (2025-12-04) The dwarf, their leader, showed the party the secret compartment under the driver's seat.
- (2025-12-04) They armed themselves from a gear pile and agreed to wait in the cave while the party pursued the other caravan.
- (2025-12-04) Muto cast Goodberry to feed them.
- (2025-12-18) The party gave berries and rations to the eight prisoners, who agreed to wait in the cave for a few days.
- (2026-01-01) The party freed six more prisoners, mostly human with one child, from the second slaver camp; they said they were captured in Elantha and were bound through the Alderwood to Sterngard and then Vestalin.
- (2026-01-01) Muto fed the new refugees Goodberries.
- (2026-01-01) The party collected the original eight refugees from the cave and brought both groups to the Pfilenese refugee camp, where residents welcomed them.
- (2026-01-01) Slight tension between the two groups faded once they realized their shared circumstances.

chunks.title: Lyndon Jorund
chunks.text:
NPC: Lyndon Jorund (first seen 2025-12-04, last seen 2026-02-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: heir of Baron Elias Jorund
Faction: Baron Jorund's press gang
Location: Aldervale
- (2025-12-04) He signed the letter found in the wagon ledger ordering the collection of Pfilenese miners and a meeting with another caravan.
- (2026-01-15) Corwynn identified six recent ledger entries as written by the same hand that signed the letter, Lyndon Jorund's.
- (2026-01-29) The deciphered ledger showed periodic audits signed off by Lyndon Jorund.
- (2026-02-12) Lyndon arrived at the Mountain Inn with his father Baron Elias Jorund and a retinue.
- (2026-02-12) Lyndon joined the card game at the Thief & Chain and raised the stakes from silver to gold.
- (2026-02-12) Lyndon grew suspicious when Allyn clumsily steered talk toward capital politics and Vestalin, and abruptly left with Ronan.
- (2026-02-12) Lyndon is described as having long blonde hair and a sneering expression.

chunks.title: Baron Elias Jorund
chunks.text:
NPC: Baron Elias Jorund (first seen 2025-12-04, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Baron Jorund, Baron Jorand
Role: baron orchestrating the press gang operation
Location: Mountain Inn
- (2025-12-04) Garuet recognized his coat of arms from the war and believes he was involved in an assault on her tribe.
- (2025-12-04) He is said to be in and out of favor with King Karlen.
- (2025-12-18) The slavers were identified by the freed prisoners as working for House Jorund, an ambitious noble whose lands border the Ruins of Vestalin.
- (2025-12-18) The party was told House Jorund was involved in driving Garuet's people from their lands.
- (2026-01-29) Baron Elias Jorund arrived in Aldervale in a carriage bearing House Jorund's arms and was recognized by Elric and Corwynn.
- (2026-02-12) Baron Elias Jorund rode into Aldervale with his heir Lyndon and lesser nobles and servants.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess described Baron Jorand as cunning and dangerous, using curiosity as a lash, and said real concern from him would be far worse.
- (2026-05-21) The Countess said Baron Elias Jorund was furious over the disappearance of his press gangs.
- (2026-06-04) The party discussed that Elias Jorund's relationship with the Countess is ambiguous, alternating between support and opposition depending on the issue.

chunks.title: Bergher
chunks.text:
NPC: Bergher (first seen 2025-12-04, last seen 2025-12-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Bergher the Red Hawk guard
Role: addressee of Lyndon Jorund's letter
Faction: House Jorund's press gang
Status: dead
- (2025-12-04) The letter found in the wagon was addressed to Bergher, presumably a press gang leader.
- (2025-12-18) Bergher was expelled from the Red Hawks and his red emblem was cut from his armor.
- (2025-12-18) Bergher was the guard who recognized Corwynn and was killed in the first encounter.
- (2025-12-18) Allyn studied Bergher's features to use later with Disguise Self.

chunks.title: Andric
chunks.text:
NPC: Andric (first seen 2025-12-18, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Andrik, Andrick
Role: rescued dwarf with knowledge of the Vestalin mines
Location: Utan's old homestead
Attitude to party: cooperative for a fee, reluctant to return to Vestalin himself
Status: alive, freed
- (2025-12-18) Andric, formerly Pfilenese, was captured while trying to reach the Plains of Drovair.
- (2025-12-18) Andric confirmed the slavers had a second supply wagon, which the ogres destroyed along with its oxen.
- (2025-12-18) Andric told the party the former Red Hawk guard who recognized Corwynn was named Bergher.
- (2025-12-18) Andric told the party the slavers worked for House Jorund, whose lands now border the Ruins of Vestalin.
- (2025-12-18) Andric recounted that miners sealed themselves inside the mines of Vestalin during the siege, and that many died, leaving ghosts and undead.
- (2026-01-01) Andric is not pleased with Allyn and would need incentive to share his knowledge of the Vestalin mines.
- (2026-03-12) Andric joined the resettlement party driving a reclaimed slaver wagon and decided to stay at the homestead for the time being.
- (2026-04-23) Andrik asked Muto for permission to clear the dead trees to expand the farmable area, and Muto approved.
- (2026-06-04) The party agreed to pay Andric five gold pieces for intelligence on secret entrances into Vestalin.
- (2026-06-18) Brother Elric confirmed this Andrik is the same dwarf known from Muto's homestead.

chunks.title: Sandor
chunks.text:
NPC: Sandor (first seen 2025-12-18, last seen 2026-01-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elf scribe and refugee
Location: Pfilenese refugee camp
Status: alive, freed
- (2025-12-18) Sandor described the turn-off point for the slavers' rendezvous, having overheard the drovers complain about the difficult path.
- (2026-01-01) Sandor asked Garuet for help finding employment and integration for the newly arrived Pfilenese, acknowledging her leadership.
- (2026-01-01) Sandor said Andric knows the Vestalin mines but would need incentive to share, and that he himself fears Vestalin and would never go.
- (2026-01-01) Sandor told Elric he was unconscious for part of a journey of no more than ten days and was kidnapped on the way to an engagement south of Elanburg.
- (2026-01-01) Sandor knew of no other movements against specific groups and agreed to pass on relevant information to Elric and the Brothers of the Silent Step.

chunks.title: Slaver guards at the stream camp
names: Slaver guards at the stream camp
chunks.text:
NPC: Slaver guards at the stream camp (first seen 2025-12-18, last seen 2025-12-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: slavers, press gang guards
Role: press gang guards holding prisoners in a cage wagon
Faction: House Jorund
Location: Slaver Camp at the Stream Bank
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: defeated
- (2025-12-18) The guards were armed with maces, heavy crossbows and longswords, with overwatch posted on a bluff.
- (2025-12-18) A slaver on the cart hit Muto with a critical heavy crossbow shot.
- (2025-12-18) Allyn killed the burly longsword-wielding leader with a short sword thrust and a scimitar slash across the throat.
- (2025-12-18) The party defeated the slavers with no party fatalities.

chunks.title: Sidsha
chunks.text:
NPC: Sidsha (first seen 2026-01-01, last seen 2026-01-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: spokesperson for the six rescued Pfilenese refugees
Attitude to party: wants to stay with the party for safety
Status: alive, freed
- (2026-01-01) Sidsha introduced himself and spoke for the six rescued prisoners, who were beaten and malnourished.
- (2026-01-01) Sidsha asked that the group be called refugees or Pfilenese rather than prisoners.
- (2026-01-01) Sidsha said the group wanted to remain with the party for safety.

chunks.title: Barton
chunks.text:
NPC: Barton (first seen 2026-01-01, last seen 2026-01-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Aldervale militiaman on gate duty
Location: Aldervale gate
- (2026-01-01) Barton challenged the party at Aldervale's gate on the evening of the ninth of Life.
- (2026-01-01) Barton directed the party to take the refugees to the refugee camp and promised to send food and supplies.

chunks.title: Hanin
chunks.text:
NPC: Hanin (first seen 2026-01-01, last seen 2026-05-21) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Lady Hanin
Role: major-domo of the Countess's estate
Faction: Countess Hargan
Location: Countess's Estate, Aldervale
Attitude to party: welcoming
- (2026-01-01) Hanin delivered the Countess's invitation to tea at Carder's shop, two bells after high sun, and said the party should dress better.
- (2026-01-01) Hanin escorted the party through the Countess's estate to the porch.
- (2026-03-12) Lady Hanin initially mistook Brother Elric for someone seeking alms, then recognized him as 'the one'.
- (2026-03-12) Lady Hanin gave Elric a warm towel and magical self-warming slippers.
- (2026-03-12) Lady Hanin gifted the slippers to Elric as he departed, telling him to keep them and think kindly of them.
- (2026-03-12) Lady Hanin greeted the whole party at the manor and led them to a smaller parlor with a round table set for seven.
- (2026-05-21) Lady Hanin met the party at the Countess's door and said they were expected.
- (2026-05-21) Lady Hanin was tasked with preparing a formal missive to the Father Abbot.

chunks.title: Raeve Amel
chunks.text:
NPC: Raeve Amel (first seen 2026-01-01, last seen 2026-05-21) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Rave Amel, Raev Amel
Role: priestess at the Temple of Order
Location: Temple of Order, Aldervale
Attitude to party: warm, welcoming
- (2026-01-01) Raeve Amel subtly cast Zone of Truth during the tea, which Muto and Asher detected, and dropped it after the Countess closed the slaver matter.
- (2026-01-01) Raeve Amel walked the party to the Temple of Order and asked them to investigate a creature haunting the refugee camp since Triskelion.
- (2026-01-01) Raeve suggested Corwynn might be suited to dealing with undead.
- (2026-01-29) Raeve Amel thanked Garuet for dealing with the skulks and bought her breakfast.
- (2026-01-29) Raeve Amel said she was exiled to Aldervale for progressive views that the Temple of Order should serve all people, not just Elanthans, and she dislikes the occupation of Pfilen.
- (2026-01-29) Raeve Amel promised to collect townspeople's donations for refugee clothing.
- (2026-01-29) Raeve Amel listened to Corwynn's embellished adventure tales and promised to seek his aid for the poor if needed.
- (2026-03-12) Raeve Amel told Corwynn she studied the economic and emotional toll of the war in the capital before being assigned to Aldervale.
- (2026-03-12) Raeve Amel said the burden of healing the community falls largely on her alone and welcomed Corwynn's offer of help.
- (2026-05-07) Raev Amel welcomed Corwynn's help treating commoners after the festival.
- (2026-05-07) Raev Amel stabilized Ronan after the duel and had him taken to the temple.

chunks.title: Raeve Amel (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Raeve Amel (first seen 2026-01-01, last seen 2026-05-21) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-21) Raev Amel accompanied the party to see Ronan and stabilized him during his seizure.
- (2026-05-21) Raev Amel said the compulsion would expire within thirty days on its own.

chunks.title: Skulks
chunks.text:
NPC: Skulks (first seen 2026-01-15, last seen 2026-01-15) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: skulk
Role: monstrous fae predators from the Shadowfell that feed on despair
Location: Pfilenese refugee camp
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: three killed
- (2026-01-15) Skulks are normally invisible to adults, but children can see them.
- (2026-01-15) Carder Mane identified the creatures haunting the refugee camp as skulks.
- (2026-01-15) Skulks can convert victims into more skulks and may take up a sinister imitation of a victim's life.
- (2026-01-15) A skulk revealed by the charnel candle shifted to resemble the missing lonely refugee.
- (2026-01-15) Garuet cleaved the first skulk from shoulder to hip with her great axe and it collapsed into ectoplasm.
- (2026-01-15) Allyn defeated the second skulk with his short sword and scimitar.
- (2026-01-15) A third skulk wounded Anson from behind, resisted Asher's Mind Sliver, and was killed by Corwynn's Guiding Bolt.
- (2026-01-15) The party harvested claws, animus, ectoplasm, skin and hearts from the skulks.

chunks.title: Johni
chunks.text:
NPC: Johni (first seen 2026-01-15, last seen 2026-01-15) [unconfirmed record]
Role: child refugee who can see skulks
Location: Pfilenese refugee camp
Attitude to party: excited, friendly
Status: alive, wounded and healed
- (2026-01-15) Johni entered Allyn's tent and gasped at another tent, and told Garuet something was inside it.
- (2026-01-15) A third skulk attacked Johni from behind and Corwynn carried him to safety and healed him.
- (2026-01-15) Johni called watching the skulks die 'super neat' and begged the party to do it again; his mother scolded him and hauled him away.

chunks.title: Cardin
chunks.text:
NPC: Cardin (first seen 2026-01-15, last seen 2026-01-15) [unconfirmed record]
Role: militia guard patrolling the refugee camp
Faction: Alderville militia
Location: Pfilenese refugee camp
Status: alive
- (2026-01-15) Cardin arrived with Anson, weapons drawn and carrying a torch, during the skulk fight.
- (2026-01-15) The militia offered to collect the skulk bodies and take them to headquarters after harvesting.

chunks.title: Lonely refugee
chunks.text:
NPC: Lonely refugee (first seen 2026-01-15, last seen 2026-01-15) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: missing refugee
Role: refugee whose wife and child vanished in the war
Status: missing, believed killed by a skulk
- (2026-01-15) His abandoned tent held a small family portrait he would never have left behind.
- (2026-01-15) Garuet and Allyn remembered him as a lonely man pitied in the camp, who would play with children.
- (2026-01-15) A skulk took on his appearance and rummaged through his belongings.

chunks.title: Borden
chunks.text:
NPC: Borden (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-01-29) [unconfirmed record]
Role: militiaman
- (2026-01-29) Borden used a magical scroll to seal the Berius cave entrance, causing a rumbling after which it looked as if the cave had never existed.

chunks.title: Duergar
chunks.text:
NPC: Duergar (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-01-29) [unconfirmed record]
Role: gray-skinned dwarves, raiders
- (2026-01-29) Duergar are described as gray-skinned, white or red-haired dwarves who worship the banished and smell like death.
- (2026-01-29) Duergar raided a lumber camp and killed workers.

chunks.title: Ames Caelwyn
chunks.text:
NPC: Ames Caelwyn (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Ames
Role: squire traveling with the visiting nobles; future Baron Caelwyn; Elric's younger brother
Location: Aldervale
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-01-29) Elric saw his younger brother Ames joking with other nobles among the arrivals.
- (2026-02-12) Ames was treated as a hanger-on at the card game, sent for drinks and not invited to play.
- (2026-02-12) Ames told Asher his analysis of each player's temperament and skill, naming Allyn the best player.
- (2026-02-12) Ames told Asher he is heir apparent after his brother's death in the war and an apprentice alchemist under Carder Mane.
- (2026-02-12) Ames expressed excitement about the party's fireworks project and interest in visiting Asher's shop.
- (2026-03-12) The Countess revealed Ames is Eldran Caelwyn's (Brother Elric's) brother and current heir, whose father's health is failing.
- (2026-03-12) Elric passed an insight check and was certain the Countess's interest in Ames is genuine.
- (2026-04-09) At the end of the session the GM and Elric's player agreed to develop Ames's personality and his relationship with Elric before their next meeting.
- (2026-04-23) Ames is in Aldervale among the visiting nobility, and Elric both fears being discovered by him and wants him as an intelligence source.
- (2026-04-23) Ames had expressed interest in visiting Carder Mane's shop and meeting the alchemist, and the party plans to use that as a pretext for a secret reunion.

chunks.title: Ames Caelwyn (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Ames Caelwyn (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-04-23) Elric found no sign of Ames during the White Night festivities.
- (2026-05-07) Ames came down the Mountain Inn stairs and Asher agreed to introduce him to Carder Mane's shop.
- (2026-05-07) Ames recognized Brother Elric on the bridge near the watermill and asked 'You're not really Elric, are you?'
- (2026-05-07) Elric confirmed he is Eldran Caelwyn, whom Ames believed dead since the siege of Vestalin.
- (2026-05-07) Ames shared news of their father's decline and his own impending rise to Baron Caelwyn.
- (2026-05-07) Elric asked Ames to keep his survival secret and to send greetings to Celine.
- (2026-05-07) Ames toured the refugee camp with Elric.
- (2026-05-07) Ames confirmed that Linden Jorand had a talent for manipulation like the card game setup Allyn described.
- (2026-06-04) The party discussed House Caelwyn's limited influence and that Ames appears to share Brother Elric's political views.

chunks.title: Horton Overbridge
chunks.text:
NPC: Horton Overbridge (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-02-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: knight-errant, duelist and instructor at arms to Lyndon Jorund
Location: Aldervale
Faction: Jorund delegation
- (2026-01-29) Elric recognized Horton Overbridge, described as a suck-up, among the arriving nobles.
- (2026-02-12) Horton played in Allyn's card game at the Thief & Chain and proved a skillful bluffer, the most dangerous opponent.
- (2026-02-12) Horton is described as bald, green-eyed and short-bearded, not committed to any house but believing House Jorund is the place to be.
- (2026-02-12) Horton tossed Allyn a gold coin as a tip for dealing when the game ended.

chunks.title: Horst Veldt
chunks.text:
NPC: Horst Veldt (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-02-12) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Horst, Sturmgarter noble, Horst Veld, Horst Velt
Role: Sturmgarder noble
Faction: Jorund delegation
Location: Aldervale
Attitude to party: dismissive
- (2026-01-29) Horst complained about being in Aldervale and was told to seek games of chance if bored.
- (2026-01-29) Horst gave Asher and Garuet a dismissive look at the inn door and left for the Thief and Chain.
- (2026-01-29) Allyn followed Horst through the market disguised as a merchant.
- (2026-02-12) Allyn followed Horst Velt to the Thief & Chain after overhearing him ask in the market about games of chance.
- (2026-02-12) Horst arranged a card game with Allyn, then returned with Horton Overbridge and Winfield Enderton.
- (2026-02-12) Horst played aggressively but without much skill.
- (2026-02-12) Horst inadvertently said that something in the tunnels keeps eating the miners at Vestalin.
- (2026-02-12) Garuet muttered an insult in Golkas at Horst as he passed; he did not understand it.

chunks.title: Ra' Vager Goliath guard
chunks.text:
NPC: Ra' Vager Goliath guard (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-01-29) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Goliath footman
Role: footman and guard
Faction: House Jorund; Ra' Vagers clan
Location: Mountain Inn
Attitude to party: hostile to Garuet
- (2026-01-29) Garuet recognized him by his clan markings as one of the Ra' Vagers.
- (2026-01-29) He recognized the symbology on Garuet's shawl and became intensely hostile.
- (2026-01-29) He replied to Garuet in Golka: 'I think I hear the voice of a dead woman. Everyone knows the dead can't harm the living.'

chunks.title: Colonel Morton Binns
chunks.text:
NPC: Colonel Morton Binns (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-01-29) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: the colonel, Colonel Morton Vinze
Role: leader of the Redhawks mercenary company
Location: Pfilen
- (2026-01-29) Corwynn recalled that the colonel leads the Redhawks and is in Pfilen on anti-insurgency operations.
- (2026-01-29) Allyn learned the colonel likely lives in the Capitol or Justan.
- (2026-01-29) The ledger shows payments to 'the colonel' for clearing settlements.

chunks.title: Ronan
chunks.text:
NPC: Ronan (first seen 2026-02-12, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Ronin, Tarvhik Gothakut, Tarvhik
Role: Goliath warrior formerly of the Ravager clan
Faction: Ravagers
Location: Militia headquarters, Aldervale
Attitude to party: cooperative
Status: alive
- (2026-02-12) Garuet recognized Ronan as a member of a clan rival to her own Gar-Daingalyska.
- (2026-02-12) Ronan and Garuet stared each other down at the Mountain Inn until Asher's illusion defused the tension.
- (2026-02-12) Ronan was called upstairs by Lyndon Jorund and withdrew reluctantly, keeping his eyes on Garuet and Asher.
- (2026-02-12) Ronan was found guarding a suite door upstairs, cleaning his fingernails with a dagger, and dismissed the feigning-drunk Elric toward the jakes out back.
- (2026-02-12) Ronan left the card game with Lyndon when Lyndon grew suspicious of Allyn.
- (2026-02-12) Ronan's shadow was seen ducking into trees between the Countess's estate and the Mountain Inn, and Allyn later found fresh size 14 boot prints circling back toward the inn's rear entrance.
- (2026-02-12) The party concluded Lyndon sent Ronan to gather intelligence on them, particularly Allyn and Muto.
- (2026-02-12) GMAssistant describes Ronan as just over 7 feet tall and slightly shorter than Garuet.
- (2026-04-23) The party is wary of a confrontation between Garuet and Ronan, with whom she has a past conflict.
- (2026-05-07) Ronan crossed the bridge into the refugee camp with two House Jorand armsmen and issued a formal honor challenge to Garuet as warrior of the Gar-Daingalyska.

chunks.title: Ronan (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Ronan (first seen 2026-02-12, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-07) Ronan wanted Garuet dead, according to his second Bert.
- (2026-05-07) Linden Jorand fired Ronan after a fight and threatened him with prison or death if he returned to the capital.
- (2026-05-07) Elric shadowed Ronan drinking heavily at the Thief in Chain and saw him open a bag of gold, concluding he was paid to provoke the fight.
- (2026-05-07) Garuet defeated Ronan in the glaive duel at the lumber mill, knocking him unconscious with a blow to his sword arm.
- (2026-05-07) The visiting nobles abandoned Ronan after the duel and the militia restrained him while he was carried to the temple.
- (2026-05-21) Garuet greeted Ronan in Golka and challenged his claim that the Gar-Daingalyska had wronged his clan.
- (2026-05-21) Ronan said the Ravagers were told the Gar-Daingalyska planned a surprise attack, so a war band slaughtered a party of Garuet's people.
- (2026-05-21) Garuet said none of her warriors returned and that the Ravagers alone among neighboring clans did not answer when Elantha besieged her people.
- (2026-05-21) Ronan and Garuet realized both clans had been manipulated into destroying each other.
- (2026-05-21) Ronan pledged his life to Garuet.
- (2026-05-21) When Garuet pressed him about House Jorund, Ronan said he was constrained, not unwilling, and then collapsed in a seizure.
- (2026-05-21) Raev Amel and Corwynn stabilized Ronan, who then rested in his bunk.

chunks.title: Ronan (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Ronan (first seen 2026-02-12, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-21) Garuet gave Ronan the new name Tarvhik Gothakut, meaning one on the threshold of full clan membership.
- (2026-06-04) Corwynn sought Ronan/Tahrvik out on the morning of Seaday, Life 18, and relieved him of the Geas the Jorunds had placed on him.
- (2026-06-04) Garuet questioned him about the Ra'vagers and the Jorunds, including their friends, allies and enemies.
- (2026-06-18) Tarvhik told the party about House Jorund's plan to absorb House Caelwyn and expand its influence across former Pfilen.
- (2026-06-18) Tarvhik said Baron Elias Jorund dreams of being crowned Count of Pfilen.
- (2026-06-18) Tarvhik described the Ravagers as a Goliath clan that accepts outcasts and even humans.
- (2026-06-18) Tarvhik spoke of a mysterious priest of a banished power who met secretly with the Baron.
- (2026-06-18) Tarvhik casually listed Countess Hargan as neutral to House Jorund, startling Muto and Garuet.
- (2026-06-18) Muto's insight check found Tarvhik was sincere about the Countess.
- (2026-06-18) Tarvhik suggested the Flayers might be worth seeking out for anyone opposed to the occupation.

chunks.title: Winfield Enderton
chunks.text:
NPC: Winfield Enderton (first seen 2026-02-12, last seen 2026-02-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: spellcaster from the Royal College of Magic, considering a position with House Jorund
Faction: Jorund delegation
Location: Aldervale
Status: alive
- (2026-02-12) Winfield joined Allyn's card game at the Thief & Chain and played cautiously, reading people well.
- (2026-02-12) Winfield quickly corrected Horst after Horst let slip that something in the tunnels keeps eating the miners, saying the rebels brought the mines down.
- (2026-02-12) Winfield praised King Karlen Elanian and adhered to the party line on Vestalin.

chunks.title: Oswald Stinson
chunks.text:
NPC: Oswald Stinson (first seen 2026-02-12, last seen 2026-02-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: proprietor of the Thief & Chain, former adventurer
Location: Thief & Chain
- (2026-02-12) Oswald keeps a hand-and-a-half sword above the bar and enforces a strict no fights in the bar rule.

chunks.title: Cave ambush creatures
chunks.text:
NPC: Cave ambush creatures (first seen 2026-03-12, last seen 2026-03-12) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: stalactite creature, stalagmite creature, parasol creatures
Role: predators camouflaged as cave formations
Location: Underdark cavern below the chasm
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2026-03-12) A creature disguised as a stalactite crept toward Allyn; it was knocked down by Garuet's thrown trident and revealed a large red eye and a toothy maw.
- (2026-03-12) Elric's thrown dagger bounced harmlessly off the fallen creature's hard skin.
- (2026-03-12) A spinning upside-down-parasol creature dropped onto Allyn, blinding and suffocating him.
- (2026-03-12) A second parasol creature dropped onto Asher; Muto as a lion clawed at it and Corwynn's guiding bolt killed it.
- (2026-03-12) A creature disguised as a stalagmite grappled Muto, dragged him thirty feet, poisoned him and bit him heavily.

chunks.title: Darkmantle
chunks.text:
NPC: Darkmantle (first seen 2026-03-26, last seen 2026-03-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: ceiling-dwelling ambush predator camouflaged as a stalactite
Location: Underdark cavern and stream
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-03-26) The darkmantle dropped onto Allyn and wrapped around his head, blinding him.
- (2026-03-26) Allyn drove both blades through the darkmantle from the inside and killed it.

chunks.title: Roper
chunks.text:
NPC: Roper (first seen 2026-03-26, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: predatory aberration with rock-like hide, single eye, toothy maw and lashing tentacles
Location: Underdark cavern and stream
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-03-26) The roper grappled Corwynn with a tentacle and dragged him thirty feet through the knee-deep water.
- (2026-03-26) The roper bit Muto and lashed at Asher and Corwynn; Asher's Shield spell stopped a tentacle from grappling him.
- (2026-03-26) Corwynn's guiding bolt marked the roper and Allyn killed it with a short sword strike.
- (2026-03-26) The roper had eaten a humanoid adventurer and swallowed fist-sized gold nuggets.
- (2026-03-26) The party identified the roper as a rare-tier creature and harvested its hide, blood and teeth.
- (2026-04-09) Allyn landed the killing blow on the roper, and a piercer also dropped from the ceiling mid-fight.
- (2026-04-09) Muto explained the gold nuggets in the roper's stomach were digestive aids, and someone dubbed the roper a one percenter.

chunks.title: Piercers
chunks.text:
NPC: Piercers (first seen 2026-03-26, last seen 2026-03-26) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: piercer, living stalactite
Role: small stalactite-like ambush predators, similar to a miniature roper with no tentacles
Location: Underdark cavern and stream
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-03-26) A piercer dropped from the ceiling and nearly pinned Brother Elric, who dodged and took only a glancing blow.
- (2026-03-26) Garuet and Elric finished off the remaining piercer.

chunks.title: Stirge swarm
chunks.text:
NPC: Stirge swarm (first seen 2026-03-26, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: stirges, stirge nesting colony
Role: swarm of four-winged blood-draining flyers with needle-like proboscises
Location: Glowing Fungus Cavern
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-03-26) Asher's Shatter exploded several of the first stirges to arrive.
- (2026-03-26) The swarm latched onto Allyn and Muto and drained their blood.
- (2026-03-26) Corwynn's Radiant Flash seared the swarm, which failed its save.
- (2026-03-26) Asher's Mind Sliver hurt the swarm and made it more vulnerable to the next save.
- (2026-03-26) Brother Elric struck down two individual stirges.
- (2026-03-26) Garuet's greataxe sweep killed the rest of the swarm.
- (2026-04-09) Asher opened the fight with shatter and Corwynn struck with radiant flash; Garuet's X-shaped greataxe sweep finished the swarm and made her MVP of the fight.

chunks.title: Beetle Knights
chunks.text:
NPC: Beetle Knights (first seen 2026-04-09, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: orange Beetle Knight, green Beetle Knight
Role: insectoid ambush predators with long serrated forelimb blades and thick carapaces, capable of short flights
Location: Luminous Fungus Chamber
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-09) Two Beetle Knights climbed out of the crevasse in the Luminous Fungus Chamber and attacked the party.
- (2026-04-09) Asher tried to put one to sleep with his staff of sleep, but it resisted the effect.
- (2026-04-09) Allyn marked the orange one with hunter's mark and landed a critical crossbow hit that badly wounded it.
- (2026-04-09) Muto knocked a flying Beetle Knight out of the air with a starry wisp as an attack of opportunity, killing it instantly.
- (2026-04-09) The party harvested carapaces, mandibles, blades, eyes and animus from the Beetle Knights and the hulking creature.

chunks.title: Hulking insectoid creature
chunks.text:
NPC: Hulking insectoid creature (first seen 2026-04-09, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: hulking monstrosity, hulking creature
Role: massive insectoid predator with large pincers and glowing eyes capable of a dazing gaze
Location: Luminous Fungus Chamber
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-09) It burst out of a stone column mid-fight and grabbed Asher in its pincers, even though Corwynn's warding flare imposed disadvantage.
- (2026-04-09) Its gaze in a 30-foot cone briefly dazed Allyn and Corwynn.
- (2026-04-09) Garuet killed it with a critical glaive blow that carved from its shoulder to its opposite hip.

chunks.title: Dead adventurer
chunks.text:
NPC: Dead adventurer (first seen 2026-04-09, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: adventurer killed by the roper
Location: Underdark cavern and stream
Status: dead
- (2026-04-09) The party found the adventurer's remains bitten in half beneath the roper, with a valise still intact.

chunks.title: Muto's mother
chunks.text:
NPC: Muto's mother (first seen 2026-04-23, last seen 2026-04-23) [unconfirmed record]
Location: Muto's residence, Aldervale
Status: alive
- (2026-04-23) She gave Muto the Countess's letter when he returned to town.

chunks.title: Bert
chunks.text:
NPC: Bert (first seen 2026-05-07, last seen 2026-05-07) [unconfirmed record]
Role: House Jorand armsman; Ronan's reluctant second
Faction: House Jorand
Attitude to party: apologetic
Status: alive
- (2026-05-07) Bert was assigned as Ronan's second out of pity by his sergeant.
- (2026-05-07) Bert told Allyn that Ronan wanted Garuet dead and had been fired by Linden.

chunks.title: Linden Jorand
chunks.text:
NPC: Linden Jorand (first seen 2026-05-07, last seen 2026-05-07) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Linden
Role: young noble of House Jorand
Faction: House Jorand
Status: alive
- (2026-05-07) Linden fired Ronan, ordered his belongings moved from the Mountain Inn to the Thief in Chain and told guards to give Ronan no aid.
- (2026-05-07) Ames said Linden has a talent for manipulation, which led Allyn to realize his card game arrest was a setup.

chunks.title: Ghasts
chunks.text:
NPC: Ghasts (first seen 2026-06-04, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
Role: undead thralls of the wight
Location: Abandoned Mountain Monastery
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-06-04) The ghasts appeared to be former bandits transformed into undead by the wight.
- (2026-06-04) Garuet killed one ghast with a critical hit from her great axe for 29 damage, then obliterated a second and later cleaved through another.
- (2026-06-04) A ghast bit Garuet and inflicted a necrotic wound, but she shook off the numbing sensation.
- (2026-06-04) The party was cleared of all ghasts by the end of the fight.

chunks.title: Skull-faced wight
chunks.text:
NPC: Skull-faced wight (first seen 2026-06-04, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: wight
Role: undead leader of the ghasts, possibly a former warlock who died before fulfilling a pact with its patron
Location: Abandoned Mountain Monastery
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-06-04) The wight loosed a stream of dark energy at Asher that struck the rock he was using for cover.
- (2026-06-04) The wight drove its claws into Allyn, draining his life essence and reducing his maximum hit points.
- (2026-06-04) Garuet hit the wight with a max-damage Great Weapon Master bonus attack.
- (2026-06-04) Asher finished the wight with a chromatic orb of lightning.

chunks.title: Gaumeo
chunks.text:
NPC: Gaumeo (first seen 2026-06-18, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: chief of the Ravagers
Faction: Ravagers
- (2026-06-18) Gaumeo was named as chief of the Ravagers, a Goliath clan that accepts outcasts and humans.

chunks.title: Spectral Form
chunks.text:
NPC: Spectral Form (first seen 2026-06-18, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: spectral undead entity
Role: incorporeal undead guardian, possibly a ghost, specter or wraith
Location: Crystal Cavern
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-06-18) It materialized before Muto's owl familiar and destroyed it instantly with a necrotic strike.

chunks.title: Bugbear Stalkers
chunks.text:
NPC: Bugbear Stalkers (first seen 2026-06-18, last seen 2026-07-02) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: bugbears
Role: ambushers armed with morning stars, longbows and javelins
Location: Mountain Stream Ford
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-06-18) They ambushed the party at the stream ford with longbows from the far bluff and a hidden bugbear in the brush.
- (2026-06-18) Asher's Chromatic Orb bounced between three bugbears, killing two outright, with a critical on the second.
- (2026-06-18) Garuet and the party finished the rest and the bugbears were all defeated.
- (2026-07-02) The five bugbears bore clan markings Garuet did not recognize, suggesting they were not local.
- (2026-07-02) The five bugbears were the only inhabitants of their camp, which the party looted.

chunks.title: The Flayers
chunks.text:
NPC: The Flayers (first seen 2026-06-18, last seen 2026-07-02) [unconfirmed record]
Role: insurgents fighting the Elanthan occupation
Attitude to party: unknown
Location: Jessain and surroundings
- (2026-06-18) The Flayers have been causing the Elanthan army significant difficulty and target King Karlen's army.
- (2026-06-18) Whether they can be trusted remains an open question.
- (2026-07-02) Wanted posters calling the Flayers a gang, terrorists or insurgents were plastered across Jessain.
- (2026-07-02) The Flayers raid warehouses and trade caravans to disrupt the occupiers.

chunks.title: Gordo
chunks.text:
NPC: Gordo (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: ironmonger and market middleman
Location: Jessain market
Attitude to party: warm, helpful
Status: alive
- (2026-07-02) Gordo explained that the new governor Perlis and his Redhawk enforcers have a chokehold on Jessain's economy.
- (2026-07-02) Gordo was interested in the party's flour and directed them to the Smith Brothers Bakery.
- (2026-07-02) Gordo agreed to ask around about selling the party's weapons and told them to return the next day.
- (2026-07-16) Gordo warned the party not to use the word 'weapons' in polite company.
- (2026-07-16) Gordo referred the party to a buyer on the west side of town and to the curio shop.

chunks.title: Bob Smith
chunks.text:
NPC: Bob Smith (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-02) [unconfirmed record]
Role: owner of the Smith Brothers Bakery
Location: Smith Brothers Bakery, Jessain
Attitude to party: gruff but reasonable, became cooperative
Status: alive
- (2026-07-02) After persuasion from Brother Elric and Asher, Bob Smith agreed to trade a letter of credit for 50 loaves of bread for the party's two sacks of flour.
- (2026-07-02) Bob Smith bought the party's cinnamon for ten silver pieces and a fresh loaf of bread.
- (2026-07-02) Bob Smith revealed the new governor is cruel and advised the party to steer clear of the Redhawks.

chunks.title: Brother Bob
chunks.text:
NPC: Brother Bob (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: monk of the Brothers of the Silent Step running an aid station
Faction: Brothers of the Silent Step
Location: Shrine of the Silent Step, Jessain
Attitude to party: helpful
Status: alive
- (2026-07-02) Brother Elric was reunited with Brother Bob, an old acquaintance.
- (2026-07-02) Brother Bob received the letter of credit with immense gratitude.
- (2026-07-02) Brother Bob explained that Governor Perlis is squeezing the city dry, the Redhawks are cracking down on suspected disloyalty, and the Flayers are fighting an insurgency.
- (2026-07-30) Brother Bob introduced the party to Wyatt Hand and his intercession won them a half-price discount on cold weather gear.

chunks.title: Gort
chunks.text:
NPC: Gort (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-02) [unconfirmed record]
Role: bouncer at the Salty Sailor
Location: The Salty Sailor, Jessain
Status: alive
- (2026-07-02) Gort recognized Allyn from his earlier time in Jessain and directed him to his sister Thea.

chunks.title: Trish
chunks.text:
NPC: Trish (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: barmaid at the Salty Sailor
Location: The Salty Sailor, Jessain
Status: alive
- (2026-07-02) Trish, with a rough sense of humor, served Garuet a questionable drink.
- (2026-07-16) Trish served the party at the Salty Sailor and noted their connection to the back room clientele.

chunks.title: Governor Perlis
chunks.text:
NPC: Governor Perlis (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-30) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Governor Perrles, Perlis, Teslon Perlis
Role: new governor of Pfilen
Faction: Elanthan occupation
Location: Jessain
Status: alive
- (2026-07-02) Locals say Governor Perlis is cruel and wrings every coin from Jessain through taxes and confiscations.
- (2026-07-02) Locals say Governor Perlis takes pleasure in interrogating suspects.
- (2026-07-30) Elric, Corwynn and Asher recognized Teslon Perlis from pre-war military parades and court appearances and could pick him out of a crowd.
- (2026-07-30) Elric learned a new bureaucracy is forming around Perlis while the old nobility was disenfranchised or killed during the Elanthan occupation.

chunks.title: Elanthan Lieutenant
chunks.text:
NPC: Elanthan Lieutenant (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: young lieutenant
Role: commander of an Elanthan soldier unit
Faction: Elanthan occupation
Location: barracks outside Jessain
Attitude to party: hostile, then backed down
Status: alive
- (2026-07-16) The lieutenant declared the bread gathering at the shrine an illegal assembly by order of the Governor and threatened to order a charge.
- (2026-07-16) The lieutenant ordered his men to beat Corwynn after Corwynn's first appeal failed.
- (2026-07-16) Corwynn's appeal to shared military service persuaded the lieutenant to declare the disturbance resolved and march his men away.

chunks.title: Brothers of the Silent Step
chunks.text:
NPC: Brothers of the Silent Step (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: brothers of the order
Role: monks running the shrine and bread distribution
Location: Silent Step Shrine, Jessain
Attitude to party: grateful
- (2026-07-16) The brothers received fifty loaves of bread and distributed them to the hungry of Jessain.
- (2026-07-16) The brothers pointed the party to a blacksmith, a curio dealer and a perfumery.
- (2026-07-16) The brothers asked Brother Elric to give a sermon and advised him to work on his public speaking.

chunks.title: Brother Hercule
chunks.text:
NPC: Brother Hercule (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: brother of the Silent Step, distinctive mustache
Faction: Brothers of the Silent Step
Location: Silent Step Shrine, Jessain
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2026-07-16) Brother Hercule took Elric's parcel of letters to slip into the post-rider system.
- (2026-07-16) Brother Hercule rescued Elric's failed sermon with a better message and diplomatically told him to work on it.
- (2026-07-16) Brother Hercule escorted Garuet to a side door to meet Dandrick.

chunks.title: Brother Sebastian
chunks.text:
NPC: Brother Sebastian (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: assists with bread distribution and crowd control
Faction: Brothers of the Silent Step
Location: Silent Step Shrine, Jessain
- (2026-07-16) Brother Sebastian helped manage the crowd at the shrine.

chunks.title: Dandrick
chunks.text:
NPC: Dandrick (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: the cloaked Goliath
Role: Goliath guide and shadow protector of wayward Goliaths
Location: Hidden Dell
Attitude to party: amused
Status: alive
- (2026-07-16) Dandrick greeted Garuet by her full clan name and said he is apart from others of their kind but connected to a group hiding in the Barias.
- (2026-07-16) Dandrick had not seen others bearing the Gar-Daingalyska symbol but promised to investigate.
- (2026-07-16) Dandrick showed a flash of hope when Garuet spoke of reestablishing her people.
- (2026-07-16) Dandrick promised to find Garuet with news of Goliaths willing to join her; Garuet warned him to be wary of the Ravagers.
- (2026-07-16) Dandrick walked into a shadow and did not emerge on the other side.
- (2026-07-30) Muto and Allyn spotted Dandrick lurking in shadows near a shrine while the party waited to leave Pfilen.
- (2026-07-30) Garuet confronted Dandrick outside town; he said he changed his mind because Goliaths are unwelcome here and guiding the party to a mountain enclave was more useful.
- (2026-07-30) The party accepted Dandrick as a guide after Garuet vouched for him, and he led them into the Barriest Mountains foothills.
- (2026-07-30) Dandrick was absent during the Harrowhound ambush and claimed he was scouting behind the old cathedral; most insight checks found him sincere but Allyn drew his crossbow on him and stayed unconvinced.
- (2026-07-30) Dandrick carries large well-worn daggers in his boots, one in his hand when he reappeared.

chunks.title: Dandrick (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Dandrick (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-08-13) The party sent Dandrick ahead to scout the ruined village to test his loyalty.
- (2026-08-13) Dandrick vanished into the brush almost instantly and returned reporting a graveyard, an old woman rooting around the central dead tree, and one or two Harrowhounds.
- (2026-08-13) Dandrick reappeared in combat to strike a wounded Harrowhound with dual short swords before slipping back into the shadows.
- (2026-08-13) Dandrick warned the party that something massive was emerging from the mausoleum to the north.
- (2026-08-13) Dandrick muttered 'This is not what I signed up for.' during the fight.
- (2026-08-27) Dandrick gathered dry firewood for fires in both mausoleums and apologized to Garuet for leading the party into danger at the graveyard.
- (2026-08-27) Dandrick guided the party through game trails and goat paths, and up a stream for nearly a mile to mask their passage.
- (2026-08-27) Dandrick slept rather than take a watch, and winked at Allyn from under his hood after Torchrunner arrived.
- (2026-08-27) Dandrick explained that he wanders far from the tribe, misdirecting those who would harm his people and killing those he cannot misdirect.
- (2026-08-27) Dandrick said he would rather survive under his own code of honor than die under another's.
- (2026-08-27) Villagers told Brother Elric that Dandrick brought most of the hidden Goliath community to the dell over the past couple of years.

chunks.title: Dandrick (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Dandrick (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-08-27) Asher, Muto, and Allyn sensed an unspoken deeper relationship between Dandrick and Felix Stonecrusher.
- (2026-09-10) Dandrick sat at the opposite end of the breakfast table from Torchrunner and seemed amused by the tension.
- (2026-09-24) At Garuet's request, Dandrick stayed behind to continue finding and gathering scattered Goliaths.

chunks.title: Finston
chunks.text:
NPC: Finston (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: gnome curio shop owner
Location: Finston's Curio Shop, Jessain
Attitude to party: friendly, willing to trade
Status: alive
- (2026-07-16) Finston demonstrated the instrument of illusions and traded the Orb of Direction to Asher for it.
- (2026-07-16) Finston traded a self-mending cloak to Muto for his boots that leave animal tracks.
- (2026-07-16) Finston had no Goliath artifacts or dark vision goggles but promised to watch for them and mentioned a craftsman friend who might have a workshop.

chunks.title: The Blacksmith
chunks.text:
NPC: The Blacksmith (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: burly human smith
Role: smith and buyer of the party's looted gear
Location: The Smithy, Jessain
Attitude to party: skeptical but willing to do business
Status: alive
- (2026-07-16) The blacksmith bought the party's bugbear gear for 323 gold pieces after confirming it was not taken from soldiers.
- (2026-07-16) The blacksmith offered the party use of his forge after the evening bell for up to three workers.

chunks.title: Giselle
chunks.text:
NPC: Giselle (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: tiefling perfumer
Location: Uncommon Scents, Jessain
Attitude to party: friendly, witty
Status: alive
- (2026-07-16) Giselle agreed to trade rare magical inks for a boggle skin.
- (2026-07-16) Giselle offered her workshop after business hours for potion brewing, with room for two workers.
- (2026-07-30) Giselle told Muto and Asher she grows most of her own botanical materials but wants fresh musk glands from giant or dire mustelids such as giant weasels or badgers.
- (2026-07-30) Giselle shared a rumor that the Redhawk mercenaries were sent to investigate a ruined village outside town and encountered something mysterious.
- (2026-07-30) Muto introduced himself to Giselle as Muto of Ardenwood and offered to exchange information in the future.

chunks.title: Wyatt Hand
chunks.text:
NPC: Wyatt Hand (first seen 2026-07-30, last seen 2026-07-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: proprietor of Wyatt's Leather Works
Location: Wyatt's Leather Works, Pfilen
Attitude to party: accommodating
Status: alive
- (2026-07-30) Wyatt sold the party tailored cold weather suits at half price and delivered them by midday, fitted to all sizes including Garuet.
- (2026-07-30) Wyatt told Muto quality hides like cowhide are scarce because of the war.

chunks.title: Harrowhounds
chunks.text:
NPC: Harrowhounds (first seen 2026-07-30, last seen 2026-08-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Harrowhound, spectral hounds
Role: undead hunters from the Shadowfell (blink dog-like)
Location: Dickle graveyard
Status: dead
Faction: serve the Annis Hag
- (2026-07-30) Four Harrowhounds ambushed the party in Dickle, blinking through shadows to bite.
- (2026-07-30) Asher identified them as undead that can track prey across planes.
- (2026-07-30) The party killed all four: Elric shattered one, Garuet killed two with her axe, and Corwynn's critical Guiding Bolt detonated the last.
- (2026-08-13) Harrowhounds served the Annis Hag in the graveyard; one walked at her side when she greeted the party.
- (2026-08-13) Garuet in a rage cleaved one Harrowhound with her great axe, finishing it.
- (2026-08-13) One Harrowhound bit Allyn with necrotic energy.
- (2026-08-13) Muto finished a wounded Harrowhound with Starry Wisp, and Corwynn and Brother Elric also struck them down.

chunks.title: Zombie troll
chunks.text:
NPC: Zombie troll (first seen 2026-07-30, last seen 2026-08-27) [unconfirmed record]
Role: undead ambusher
Location: Dickle
Status: dead
- (2026-07-30) The zombie troll rose from among the ruins disguised as a rock and fought with a morning star.
- (2026-07-30) It regenerated after first falling and knocked Allyn prone with two blows.
- (2026-07-30) Asher's acid Chromatic Orb dissolved its remains so it could not rise again.
- (2026-08-27) Garuet took a tibia from the zombie troll's remains for future crafting.

chunks.title: Annis Hag
chunks.text:
NPC: Annis Hag (first seen 2026-08-13, last seen 2026-08-27) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: old woman, hunched older woman
Role: hag who commanded the graveyard's undead
Location: Dickle graveyard
Attitude to party: hostile after a false friendly greeting
Status: dead
- (2026-08-13) The Annis Hag first appeared as a hunched old woman who called the party 'dearies' and said gnomes were 'tasty'.
- (2026-08-13) When Garuet asked if she had come through a rift recently, she deflected, saying that was her business.
- (2026-08-13) When Muto moved against her, she transformed into a much larger monstrous form and conjured a fog cloud.
- (2026-08-13) The hag grappled Muto and bit him while her giant zombie battered him unconscious.
- (2026-08-13) Allyn killed the hag with his magical short sword from the darkness.
- (2026-08-13) Muto and Asher identified her as an Annis Hag, likely from the Shadowfell, which explained the mist and undead.
- (2026-08-13) Allyn took her scalp as a trophy.
- (2026-08-27) Asher took the Annis Hag's brain and Allyn took some of her hair as harvest.
- (2026-08-27) The Annis Hag's satchel held a wine bottle, a tome, a leather ring, three silver trade bars, and a bag of twenty-five gold coins.
- (2026-08-27) Muto concluded the hag likely stumbled on a natural rift or opened one herself.

chunks.title: Harrowhawk
chunks.text:
NPC: Harrowhawk (first seen 2026-08-13, last seen 2026-08-13) [unconfirmed record]
Faction: serve the Annis Hag
Location: Dickle graveyard
Status: dead
- (2026-08-13) A Harrowhawk perched in the upper branches of the dead tree and chased off Muto's owl familiar, cutting off telepathic contact.
- (2026-08-13) The Harrowhawk swooped to slash Muto in lion form with necrotic claws.
- (2026-08-13) Corwynn destroyed the Harrowhawk with Sacred Flame.

chunks.title: Giant zombie
chunks.text:
NPC: Giant zombie (first seen 2026-08-13, last seen 2026-08-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: huge bloated zombie, giant zombie creature
Faction: serves the Annis Hag
Location: Dickle graveyard
Status: dead
- (2026-08-13) The giant zombie emerged from the Sepulcher mausoleum and emitted a stench that poisoned nearby party members on failed Constitution saves.
- (2026-08-13) It sprayed poisonous goo when wounded by slashing or piercing weapons and had a life-draining attack.
- (2026-08-13) It knocked Muto unconscious with slams and kicked Brother Elric.
- (2026-08-13) Brother Elric toppled it, Asher's Shatter did only half damage, and Garuet killed it with her maul.

chunks.title: Torchrunner Windborn
chunks.text:
NPC: Torchrunner Windborn (first seen 2026-08-27, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Torchrunner Windborne, Windborne, Windborn, Torchrunner
Role: lead hunter and scout; guide for the party out of the mountains
Faction: Hidden Goliath tribe
Location: returned toward the mountains
Attitude to party: initially resentful, then grateful
Status: alive
- (2026-08-27) Torchrunner appeared silently at the campfire during the second watch, armed with a longsword and javelins, and was welcomed by Garuet.
- (2026-08-27) Torchrunner agreed to lead the party to a local Goliath group the next morning.
- (2026-08-27) Torchrunner said he and Dandrick are from the same scattered tribe, and grudgingly accepted Dandrick's methods without approving them.
- (2026-08-27) Torchrunner asked to learn goat ball and led the party to the hidden dell.
- (2026-09-10) Torchrunner led the party to the alpine meadow and admitted he had never seen the creature, only its aftermath.
- (2026-09-10) Torchrunner was revealed to be of frost giant kin and hurled cold-infused spears from atop the boulders during the fight.
- (2026-09-10) After the battle Torchrunner admitted he was jealous at first and that alone the bulettes would have eaten him, and he thanked the party.
- (2026-09-10) Torchrunner harvested the bulette hearts for the feast and recounted the battle to the village, accepting corrections with a laugh.
- (2026-09-10) Garuet and Corwynn noticed Torchrunner felt his authority as lead hunter was being undermined by the outsiders.

chunks.title: Torchrunner Windborn (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Torchrunner Windborn (first seen 2026-08-27, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-09-24) Garuet asked for Torchrunner as the party's guide instead of Dandrick.
- (2026-09-24) Torchrunner guided the party through the mountains and foothills toward the Pass of Vestalin.
- (2026-09-24) Torchrunner stopped near the pass, saying he would be enslaved by Elanthan forces if caught there.
- (2026-09-24) Garuet addressed him as Captain at parting, and Muto gave him goodberries for the journey home.
- (2026-09-24) Allyn bid him farewell in the Goliath tongue and Torchrunner gently corrected his pronunciation.

chunks.title: Felix Stonecrusher
chunks.text:
NPC: Felix Stonecrusher (first seen 2026-08-27, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Chief Felix, Felix Stone Crusher
Role: chief of the Goliath mountain clan
Faction: Hidden Goliath tribe
Location: Hidden Dell
Attitude to party: welcoming, grateful
Status: alive
- (2026-08-27) Felix greeted Garuet in Gol-kaa and offered the party the hospitality of the hearth in his longhouse.
- (2026-08-27) Felix explained that the village is a sanctuary for scattered Goliaths, hidden by Berengar's magic and Dandrick's efforts.
- (2026-08-27) Felix appeared to be working up to a request of the party but did not make it this session.
- (2026-09-10) Felix asked the party at breakfast to stop a creature killing the tribe's oxen and sheep, and said he would not hold Torchrunner's guidance hostage to the favor.
- (2026-09-10) Felix joined the victory feast and mentioned he had fought bulettes in his past.
- (2026-09-24) Felix and Berengar presented Garuet with an ancient hide inscribed with Gulko runes.

chunks.title: Berengar Stoneshaper
chunks.text:
NPC: Berengar Stoneshaper (first seen 2026-08-27, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Berrigan Stone Shaper, Berrigan
Role: shamaness of the hidden Goliath village
Faction: Hidden Goliath tribe
Location: Hidden Dell
Attitude to party: guarded but warming
Status: alive
- (2026-08-27) Berengar performs a ritual each evening to recharge the illusion hiding the village.
- (2026-08-27) Berengar smiled when Asher praised the illusion at the village entrance.
- (2026-08-27) Berengar told Muto that she might teach him the technique once they know each other better.
- (2026-09-24) Berengar found the prophecy hide among the possessions of a long-dead shaman.
- (2026-09-24) Berengar pledged on behalf of all her people that they would answer Garuet's call when the time came.

chunks.title: Bulettes
chunks.text:
NPC: Bulettes (first seen 2026-09-10, last seen 2026-09-10) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: bulette, land sharks, orange bulette, blue bulette, purple bulette
Role: burrowing predators killing the tribe's livestock
Location: Alpine Meadow
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: two dead, one escaped underground
- (2026-09-10) Muto deduced from the single massive bites and lack of acid, fire or venom that a bulette was the culprit.
- (2026-09-10) Three bulettes ambushed the party in the meadow; the third leaped thirty feet to land before Allyn and Garuet.
- (2026-09-10) Asher trapped the first bulette with Phantasmal Force, an illusory earthen fist, and it stayed restrained for the fight.
- (2026-09-10) The orange bulette, badly wounded, burrowed away and escaped despite opportunity attacks from Allyn, Muto and Garuet.
- (2026-09-10) Allyn killed the restrained blue bulette with his short sword after leaping onto an ox carcass.
- (2026-09-10) Corwynn's Warding Flare cut the third bulette's bite on Allyn from about forty damage to twenty-four.

chunks.title: Oak troll
chunks.text:
NPC: Oak troll (first seen 2026-09-24, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: ambusher that likely destroyed the stone bridge
Location: collapsed bridge ravine
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-09-24) The oak troll hid in a leafy shroud on the riverbank and rose to ambush the party.
- (2026-09-24) It answered Garuet's parley with 'I am foe to all your kind.'
- (2026-09-24) Its leafy shroud protected it from non-fire damage, and Garuet's glaive and Muto's conjured animals did no harm.
- (2026-09-24) Asher identified it as an oak troll vulnerable to fire.
- (2026-09-24) Corwynn's fireball burned off its shroud and prevented regeneration, and Allyn killed it with a critical crossbow bolt.

chunks.title: Kruthiks
chunks.text:
NPC: Kruthiks (first seen 2026-10-08, last seen 2026-10-22)
Also known as: Kruthik, small Kruthiks, adult Kruthiks, green Kruthik
Role: burrowing insectoid ambushers
Location: Mines of Vestalin entrance cavern
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-10-08) Kruthiks burst from the churned rocky floor and ambushed the party in the entrance cavern.
- (2026-10-08) Kruthiks are monstrosities, not aberrations.
- (2026-10-08) They burrow through solid rock to reposition, use pack tactics and can launch volleys of spikes.
- (2026-10-08) Garuet killed several small Kruthiks, Corwynn's fire and Radiance of the Dawn killed others, and Asher killed one with Chromatic Orb and another with Mind Sliver.
- (2026-10-08) Brother Elric deflected a volley of Kruthik spikes and redirected the force at the creature that launched them.
- (2026-10-22) Muto's owl and the party recapped the Kruthik ambush at the start of the session: baby Kruthiks nearly bit Allyn, Garuet vaporized them, and the party eventually defeated them and began harvesting parts.
- (2026-10-22) Brother Elric chose to take the claws of the young Kruthiks, and Allyn considered the adult Kruthiks' detachable spines for crafting.

chunks.title: Kruthik Hive Lord
chunks.text:
NPC: Kruthik Hive Lord (first seen 2026-10-08, last seen 2026-10-22)
Also known as: Hive Lord, big Kruthik
Role: leader of the Kruthik pack
Location: Kruthik Hive Lord's Tunnel
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-10-08) The Hive Lord emerged from a hollow in a stone column and spewed a cone of acid that caught Elric and Allyn.
- (2026-10-08) The Hive Lord critically hit Allyn, leaving him bloodied.
- (2026-10-08) It tried to flee by burrowing, leaving a ten-foot-wide tunnel.
- (2026-10-08) Garuet's Branches of the Tree pulled it back between the party and the tunnel exit with its speed reduced to zero.
- (2026-10-08) Allyn killed the Hive Lord with a whirlwind of shortsword strikes after Garuet left it barely alive.
- (2026-10-22) The party searched the lair-like hole ten feet up the column where the big Kruthik had crawled out. Muto's owl saw metallic glints in the rock and Asher found 20 chunks of gold-bearing ore.

chunks.title: Flaming skeletons
chunks.text:
NPC: Flaming skeletons (first seen 2026-10-22, last seen 2026-10-22)
Also known as: skeletal figures, gaunt skeletal figure, skeletons with scepters
Role: guardians commanded by something else; undead from another plane
Location: cave passage south of the Kruthik cavern
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-10-22) A tall, gaunt skeletal figure with a flaming scepter was found beside a ball of flame. It cocked its head like a human, then went back to an at-ease posture while the flame ball became agitated.
- (2026-10-22) Brother Elric's bludgeoning attacks were particularly effective against the skeletons, and force damage was less effective. The skeletons vibrate and explode on death, dealing fire damage to nearby creatures (a dexterity save for half; one blast was 12).
- (2026-10-22) Corwynn's Turn Undead (DC 14 wisdom save) left one skeleton frightened and incapacitated, and Sear Undead dealt 10 radiant damage to it.
- (2026-10-22) The skeletons were immune to fire. After the fight only charred bones and burned iron scepters remained, with no treasure, and the harvestables are uncommon.
- (2026-10-22) Asher's Arcana check of 22 led the party to conclude the skeletons were placed to guard something not yet discovered. They probably came through a rift from a plane of undead or fire, and whatever commanded them likely created the flaming spheres as watchdogs.

chunks.title: Living flaming spheres
names: orange, yellow, blue and purple spheres
chunks.text:
NPC: Living flaming spheres (first seen 2026-10-22, last seen 2026-10-22)
Also known as: torch balls, flaming spheres, balls of flame, orange, yellow, blue and purple spheres
Role: constructs serving as guardian watchdogs
Location: cave passage south of the Kruthik cavern
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-10-22) A five-foot ball of flame advanced on Allyn and the fight began. Spheres of orange, yellow, blue and purple colors fought the party, giving off bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for another 20 feet.
- (2026-10-22) One sphere lashed Allyn with an attack of opportunity as he retreated (5 fire damage, 3 absorbed with Absorb Elements). The purple sphere slammed into Allyn (a dexterity save of 25 halved to 5 fire).
- (2026-10-22) Garuet's axe passed through one fire image, which the GM then swapped for a more creature-like token. The party killed the blue sphere with Asher's chromatic orb (19 cold damage) and cut one in half with Garuet's great axe. The others were damaged by Muto's Conjure Animals and died.
- (2026-10-22) Asher and Muto examined the remains and found the spheres are constructs that are not native to this plane. They are magical creations whose secret has been lost, and they acted on commands rather than their own volition.

chunks.title: Brain-beaked aberrations
chunks.text:
NPC: Brain-beaked aberrations (first seen 2026-10-22, last seen 2026-10-22)
Also known as: beaky tentacle guys, brain with a beak, bulbous floating creatures, blue and orange aberrations, large slithering aberration
Role: creatures from the portal
Location: around the cyan-glowing portal below the ledge
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-10-22) Muto's owl saw odd bulbous floating creatures near the sickly cyan portal. One looking like a brain with a beak and ugly tentacles lashed out and killed the owl, and then they turned toward the party.
- (2026-10-22) A smaller blue one, an orange one and a larger slithering one fought the party. The blue and orange ones died to Allyn, Garuet, Elric, Asher's Shatter (9 thunder) and Muto's Conjure Animals.
- (2026-10-22) The largest one slithered up onto the ledge and slammed Allyn for 9 bludgeoning, knocking him prone. It then attacked Muto (the tiger) with a tentacle that hit for 8 and grappled him, and a bite for 22 that required concentration checks.

chunks.title: Cyan portal
chunks.text:
NPC: Cyan portal (first seen 2026-10-22, last seen 2026-10-22)
Also known as: the portal, portal to the Far Realm, rift
Role: portal, sturdier than a rift, to the Far Realm
Location: cavern below the ledge, southwest of the Kruthik cavern
Status: open
- (2026-10-22) The GM ruled that this gives off a sickly cyan glow and is a portal, a class the party had not met before, not a rift. Portals take more damage to close, can be made self-sustaining and can be dispelled by a powerfully enough dispel magic.
- (2026-10-22) Garuet cleaved into the portal and it took half damage. Elric's unarmed attack did 6, and Muto's Dispel Magic failed to close it.

chunks.title: Alderville
chunks.text:
Location: Alderville (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-05-21)
Also known as: Alder Ville, Aldervale
Type: town
Description: Town with a militia, a mayor and refugee camps on its edge, set next to the Alderwood.
- (2025-08-14) Alderville has a militia led by Captain Holcroft; the militia fort is in town, and the town square lies on the way to Carter Maine's shop.
- (2025-08-14) Mayor Woodson wanted to speak with the party. The mayor's daughter greeted them in the tower after a little over an hour.
- (2025-08-14) The town houses refugees from Philen for a few days to a few weeks, then encourages them to move on toward Atlanta or the plains of Drove Air.
- (2025-10-23) The party returned after the Mayor declared it safe, intending to use crafting facilities.
- (2025-11-06) The party returned in mid-afternoon and the town felt sleepy and calm.
- (2026-01-01) The party arrived at the gate on the evening of the ninth of Life with two wagons of refugees.
- (2026-01-01) The party had tea with the Countess at her estate and visited the Temple of Order next to the town hall.
- (2026-01-29) The town prepared for the Bright Night celebration, six days away.
- (2026-04-23) The town celebrated White Night with flower garlands, music, and a fireworks display; the party returned for it.
- (2026-05-21) The visiting noble entourages left Aldervale overnight after the duel, leaving unpaid gambling debts.

chunks.title: Carter Maine's shop
chunks.text:
Location: Carter Maine's shop (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-01-15)
Also known as: Maine's shop, Carder Mane's apothecary, Carder Mane's shop
Type: alchemist shop
Parent: Alderville
Description: Musty, fragrant, untidy shop packed with components, potions, scrolls and Anima storage bottles, with a large workroom in back. Maine lives there.
- (2025-08-14) The customer area is small. Walls behind the counter hold component containers and a rack of potions and scrolls, and a separate rack holds Anima storage bottles for common and uncommon Animas. Rarer containers are stored elsewhere.
- (2025-08-14) Uton and Asher work in the back workroom. Uton cooked soup there for the refugees, filling about 24 to 32 quart jars.
- (2025-08-14) Maine lives in the shop. Uton has a home in town, as yet unplaced.
- (2025-11-06) Asher plans to use its workshop to brew potions.
- (2026-01-15) Corwynn and Asher studied the ledger there, and Carder Mane crafted the charnel candle in his workroom.

chunks.title: Mountain Inn
chunks.text:
Location: Mountain Inn (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-02-12)
Type: inn
Parent: Alderville
Description: Premier but pricey inn in Alderville.
- (2025-08-14) Asher stays in a closet-sized room at the Mountain Inn, which is pricey.
- (2025-11-06) Muto and Uton drank here and talked about the Feywild.
- (2025-11-06) Allyn, disguised, overheard the Mayor and Captain Holcroft here.
- (2026-01-29) The Jorund nobles took lodging at the inn.
- (2026-01-29) Garuet and the Goliath guard had a tense standoff there.
- (2026-02-12) Garuet and Ronan had a tense standoff on the ground floor, defused by Asher's illusion.
- (2026-02-12) Elric entered with his hood up, overheard Horst's card game plans, and went upstairs to find Ronan guarding a suite.
- (2026-02-12) The party found the stable yard guards not very vigilant, which could allow future mischief.

chunks.title: Thief in Chain
chunks.text:
Location: Thief in Chain (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-05-07)
Also known as: Thief and Chain, Thief & Chain
Type: inn
Parent: Alderville
Description: Cheaper inn by the gate, a dive.
- (2025-08-14) The Thief in Chain is down by the gate and is a dive. Maine advised Asher against moving there.
- (2025-11-06) Allyn and Garuet met Hovan Garth here at sundown.
- (2026-01-29) Allyn overheard the militiamen's Underdark talk here.
- (2026-01-29) Muto, as a cat, was directed by a barmaid to a warm spot by the fireplace.
- (2026-02-12) Allyn played cards with the nobles here, using a wagon wheel chandelier's light.
- (2026-02-12) Proprietor Oswald Stinson enforces a no fights in the bar rule.
- (2026-05-07) Ronan drank alone here the night before the duel while Elric watched.

chunks.title: Refugee Camp Number 11
chunks.text:
Location: Refugee Camp Number 11 (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-04-23)
Also known as: refugee camp, Pfilenese refugee camp
Type: refugee camp
Parent: Alderville
Description: Temporary camp of 30 to 40 refugees in a field across the bridge, beside the Alderwood.
- (2025-08-14) It lies across the bridge from town, with the mill to the left and a watchtower to the right. It has tents, truck farm plots, a latrine at the woods' edge and a pen of farm animals.
- (2025-08-14) Allyn and Garuet arrived about a week or ten days earlier and have tents there. A fight with drunk Red Hawk recruits broke out at the camp.
- (2025-11-06) Brother Elric shared food with refugee children and families here.
- (2025-11-06) Garuet received Enzo's note here, and the party gathered here to discuss plans.
- (2026-01-01) The party brought the rescued refugees here and kept both wagons in the camp.
- (2026-01-01) Children at the well described a gray, semi-transparent, people-sized creature that creeps around at night and leaves no footprints.
- (2026-01-01) The children said several refugees went missing in recent days.
- (2026-01-15) Two refugees had vanished without notice and the camp was on edge.
- (2026-01-15) Allyn found drag marks leading from an abandoned tent into the woods.
- (2026-01-15) The party fought three skulks in the camp.
- (2026-04-23) Elric learned mine entrance and smelter locations in Vestalin from newly arrived refugee families.

chunks.title: Alderwood
chunks.text:
Location: Alderwood (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-09-25)
Also known as: alder wood, Alderwood Forest
Type: forest
Description: Dense, dark, forbidding forest that spreads north and west into the mountains.
- (2025-08-14) The forest grows faster the more it is harvested, so clear cutting is avoided because crews that try it do not come back. It holds alder, oak, yew and hornbeam, turning to pine and fir near the mountains.
- (2025-09-11) The party traveled through it at night around midnight and heard gnoll howling to the southeast.
- (2025-09-11) They masked their trail by wading through a stream.
- (2025-09-25) Wildlife such as squirrels and songbirds returned to normal activity near the closed rifts.

chunks.title: Utan's old homestead
chunks.text:
Location: Utan's old homestead (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-04-23)
Also known as: old family homestead, abandoned cabin, Muto's Family Farm, Uton's Farm, Uton Estate, Muto's Homestead
Type: homestead
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Abandoned, weathered cabin with a dead-tree yard, about half a day from town.
- (2025-08-14) Muto led the party about two hours of bushwhacking to the cabin, his father's old homestead. Vine creatures, blights and a harpy attacked there.
- (2025-08-14) The harpy nested inside at night and outside by day. Its bedroom was filled with feathers, filth and half-eaten remains, and a pile of cadavers lay in the back.
- (2025-08-14) The interior is in better shape than the exterior, but only the bones of the house are of value and it would need a full rebuild. The well is still drinkable, the fruit trees are dead, and the cart could be repaired.
- (2025-08-28) The party camped outside near the well rather than in the disgusting farmhouse and took a long rest there.
- (2025-08-28) Verdina found them at their campfire there the next morning.
- (2025-09-25) It was visible from Overlook Hill to the northwest, along with the haunted tree at the location of the closed rift D.
- (2025-10-23) The party returned there by evening and found no new threats in the cleared homestead.
- (2026-03-12) The party found the homestead free of twig blights and harpies, with a clean well.
- (2026-03-12) The party converted the living room into a communal barracks and built bunks for the refugee settlers.

chunks.title: Utan's old homestead (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Utan's old homestead (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-04-23)
- (2026-04-23) Refugees at the homestead had cleared the well and turned vegetable plots.
- (2026-04-23) Muto performed an eight-hour Plant Growth ritual here, granting a year of improved harvests and thickened forest.

chunks.title: Militia tower
chunks.text:
Location: Militia tower (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2025-08-14)
Also known as: tower
Type: tower
Parent: Alderville
Description: Smells of timber, leather, oil and sweat; the river and mill can be heard.
- (2025-08-14) Captain Holcroft took the party into the tower to stay out of sight; they rested there until the mayor's daughter arrived.

chunks.title: The Ancient Tree
chunks.text:
Location: The Ancient Tree (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2025-08-28) [unconfirmed record]
Type: landmark tree
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Enormous ancient tree with a sinister reputation, a 10-foot-wide crack at its base, dense mist smelling of dank basements and corrupted earth, towering roots and dim light beneath its canopy.
- (2025-08-28) Muto remembered it from his youth, when local children dared each other to approach it; the party traveled 4 to 5 hours to reach it.
- (2025-08-28) Allyn and Elric scouted it and found the crevice was a natural formation 3 to 4 feet deep and at least 5 feet wide, not a passage.
- (2025-08-28) The first rift opened here at nightfall of the Triskelion and the party closed it.

chunks.title: Marshy Forest Crossing
chunks.text:
