Location: Marshy Forest Crossing (first seen 2025-08-28, last seen 2025-08-28) [unconfirmed record]
Type: marsh clearing
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Marshy area where the forest trail crosses a burbling stream, blocked by a large fallen tree, with bushy undergrowth and dead trees.
- (2025-08-28) Site of the battle against six dust and mud mephits; Elric found the fallen tree would need multiple people to move.

chunks.title: Feywild Rift Site
chunks.text:
Location: Feywild Rift Site (first seen 2025-09-11, last seen 2025-09-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: second rift
Type: clearing with rift
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Clearing in a cleft among shallow bluffs with a campfire, a glowing blue stone table, and a menhir of two standing stones with a crosspiece; rocks provide cover and goblin archers held the bluffs.
- (2025-09-11) The party approached it from the south and found goblins performing a ritual there.
- (2025-09-11) The party destroyed the stone table and the rift closed.
- (2025-09-11) The party planned to long rest at the former goblin campsite.

chunks.title: Forest Clearing with Standing Stones
chunks.text:
Location: Forest Clearing with Standing Stones (first seen 2025-09-25, last seen 2025-09-25) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: rift B clearing, rift location B
Type: clearing with standing stones and rift
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Small clearing with five standing stones, ringed by bluffs, with ramp, north and south approaches, a foul stench of decay and an unnaturally silent forest.
- (2025-09-25) Muto recognized the clearing from earlier walkabouts.
- (2025-09-25) The standing stones arced to life and formed a glowing pillar, and the rift manifested as a portal.
- (2025-09-25) Brother Elric smelled corruption like the battlefields of the siege of Vestalyn.

chunks.title: Overlook Hill
chunks.text:
Location: Overlook Hill (first seen 2025-09-25, last seen 2025-09-25) [unconfirmed record]
Type: hill
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Steep hill giving a view of Uton's farm to the northwest and the darker area around rift B; the climb took about half again as long in the rain.
- (2025-09-25) The party climbed it for a vantage point before approaching rift B.

chunks.title: Ancient Plinth Altar
chunks.text:
Location: Ancient Plinth Altar (first seen 2025-10-09, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: location G, Plinth Altar
Type: altar site marked as a fiendish rift on the party's map
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Ancient standing stone on a bluff above a dry streambed, with ruins around it, where gnolls held Verdina.
- (2025-10-09) The party learned it is location G, about 8 hours away.
- (2025-10-23) The party reached it through the Feywild shortcut and defeated the gnolls there, rescuing Verdina.

chunks.title: Marshy rift hillock
chunks.text:
Location: Marshy rift hillock (first seen 2025-10-09, last seen 2025-10-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Marshy Rift Site, swamp rift
Type: marshy hillock with ring of standing stones
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Standing pools of murky water, smell of sulfur and rot, difficult terrain, and a ring of standing stones with a structure at its center.
- (2025-10-09) The party traveled four hours to reach it, approaching from the south.
- (2025-10-09) No rift had appeared yet, though the enemies were trying to open one.
- (2025-10-09) Muto explained the site had existed for hundreds or thousands of years.
- (2025-10-09) The party debated whether to destroy or preserve the ancient circle.

chunks.title: Feywild
chunks.text:
Location: Feywild (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Feywild Forest
Type: plane
Description: Altered mirror of the forest with reddish-brown trees, bluish-violet grass, glowing pools, no sun and starfields through the clouds; contains fae echoes of real places.
- (2025-10-23) The party entered through a blue-flame portal at the pentagram altar and left through a pinkish-red flame portal.
- (2025-10-23) Muto marked the entry point with druidcraft.

chunks.title: Red Bark Grove
chunks.text:
Location: Red Bark Grove (first seen 2025-10-23, last seen 2025-10-23) [unconfirmed record]
Type: grove
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Ring of enormous ancient trees with reddish furry bark; the party's exit from the Feywild.
- (2025-10-23) The Feywild rift there had closed naturally when the party returned, leaving a sense of peace.

chunks.title: Militia Barracks
chunks.text:
Location: Militia Barracks (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2025-11-06) [unconfirmed record]
Type: barracks
Parent: Alderville
Description: north end of town near the bridge; mail handled through post riders
- (2025-11-06) Corwynn collected letters for himself and Brother Elric here.

chunks.title: Mira Cragshield's Forge
chunks.text:
Location: Mira Cragshield's Forge (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2025-11-20) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Mira's smithy
Type: smithy
Parent: Alderville
Description: likely uncommon quality forge near the militia barracks
- (2025-11-06) Mira said it lacks the quality to craft with rare materials.
- (2025-11-20) Garuet bought and was fitted with scale mail here.

chunks.title: Vestalin
chunks.text:
Location: Vestalin (first seen 2025-11-06, last seen 2026-10-08) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Ruins of Vestalin, mines of Vestalin
Type: ruined city and mines
Parent: Barrius Mountains
Description: Pfilenese city on the Pfilen-Elantha border, besieged and sacked in the war; rumored rare forge in its mines
- (2025-11-06) Hovan said miners there are reluctant to work, some do not return, and some of what comes out is not what went in.
- (2025-11-06) Elric and Corwynn recalled rumors of miners blockading themselves inside rather than surrendering.
- (2025-12-04) The letter said the prisoners were to be delivered to General August in Vestalin.
- (2025-12-18) Andric said the mines became haunted after the siege, with sealed-in miners dying and leaving ghosts and undead.
- (2026-05-21) Verdina said miners collapsed the tunnels to avoid enslavement and a curse binds them there.
- (2026-06-04) The party plans a future excursion to Vestalin and paid for information on secret entrances.
- (2026-07-16) LeFlay called Vestalin a pit of despair and greed, and Elric said he could find a way back in.
- (2026-10-08) The party entered the mines of Vestalin through the secret back entrance.

chunks.title: Spider clearing and chasm
chunks.text:
Location: Spider clearing and chasm (first seen 2025-11-20, last seen 2026-03-12) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: misty clearing, chasm
Type: clearing and chasm
Parent: the woods
Description: Misty clearing hung with large cobwebs, with an enormous web across a chasm in the ground.
- (2025-11-20) The party fought giant spiders and a phase spider here.
- (2025-11-20) The party judged the chasm an entrance to the Underdark because phase spiders almost never appear on the surface.
- (2025-11-20) A lit stone dropped into the chasm bounced off webbing and splashed into water far below.
- (2025-11-20) Allyn recorded the location of the entrance on a map.
- (2026-03-12) The party descended the 180-foot slick-walled chasm by rope, using a climbing kit, and reached a natural crevasse with a slow underground stream flowing east.

chunks.title: Scene of carnage on the track
names: Scene of carnage on the track
chunks.text:
Location: Scene of carnage on the track (first seen 2025-11-20, last seen 2025-12-04) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: the track, Scene of Carnage
Type: road site
Description: Less-traveled track linking two main roads, about half a day from the road down to Elanburg.
- (2025-11-20) The party found an overturned wagon, human corpses, a dead horse and a dismembered ox here.
- (2025-11-20) Allyn noted a second set of wagon ruts and large humanoid footprints suggesting another wagon went around the wreck.
- (2025-11-20) Vultures circled above and took off as the party approached.
- (2025-12-04) The party found an overturned, ransacked supply wagon, four human dead and slaughtered draft animals.
- (2025-12-04) Two sets of wagon tracks led away, one wider and heavier like a prisoner transport.

chunks.title: Underdark
chunks.text:
Location: Underdark (first seen 2025-11-20, last seen 2026-03-26) [unconfirmed record]
Type: cavern network
- (2025-11-20) The party believes the spider chasm leads to it.
- (2026-03-12) The party entered a vast damp cavern with an underground river and mushrooms of all sizes, where they were ambushed by camouflaged predators.
- (2026-03-26) The party fought a roper, a darkmantle and piercers in the cavern stream and found a dead adventurer's remains.
- (2026-03-26) The party followed the underground stream east and then downstream and exited to the surface.

chunks.title: Ogre Cave
chunks.text:
Location: Ogre Cave (first seen 2025-12-04, last seen 2025-12-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Waterfall Cave Entrance
Type: cave
Description: Vine-draped cave behind a waterfall, reeking of blood and musk, holding an armored wagon, a nest of furs and a gear pile.
- (2025-12-04) The party fought two worgs and two ogres here and freed eight prisoners.
- (2025-12-04) They camped here for the night.
- (2025-12-18) The party woke here after a long rest, burned the ogre corpses outside and left the freed prisoners to wait.

chunks.title: Slaver Camp at the Stream Bank
names: Slaver Camp at the Stream Bank
chunks.text:
Location: Slaver Camp at the Stream Bank (first seen 2025-12-18, last seen 2026-01-01) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: slaver camp
Type: slaver camp
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Hidden camp along a stream bank with a dim campfire, a cage wagon of prisoners and guards on a bluff overwatch.
- (2026-01-01) The party camped here overnight, judged it rarely used and left at dawn on the eighth of Life.

chunks.title: Weed-choked ravine
chunks.text:
Location: Weed-choked ravine (first seen 2026-01-01, last seen 2026-01-01) [unconfirmed record]
Type: ravine
Parent: Alderwood
Description: natural depression near the slaver camp
- (2026-01-01) The party hid the cage wagon here under brush and brambles so it could be recovered later.

chunks.title: Countess's Estate
chunks.text:
Location: Countess's Estate (first seen 2026-01-01, last seen 2026-05-21) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Countess Hargan's Manor
Type: estate
Parent: Aldervale
Description: dark-stained oak entryway with ebony and red wood accents, a dining room seating thirty to forty, and a smaller parlor with a round table
- (2026-01-01) The party took tea with the Countess on the porch.
- (2026-03-12) The party lunched here with the Countess and received her warning about Baron Jorand.
- (2026-05-21) The party met the Countess in her library, where cups were set out for exactly the number of guests.

chunks.title: Temple of Order
chunks.text:
Location: Temple of Order (first seen 2026-01-01, last seen 2026-05-07) [unconfirmed record]
Type: temple
Parent: Aldervale
Description: large imposing building next to the city hall
- (2026-01-01) It is Raeve Amel's base of operations.
- (2026-05-07) Ronan was taken here for treatment after the duel.

chunks.title: Berius Mountains
chunks.text:
Location: Berius Mountains (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-07-30) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Barriest Mountains
Type: mountain range
Description: Rugged range said to hold Goliath enclaves; the secret mine entrance lies on its far side.
- (2026-01-29) Militiamen found and sealed a cave here believed to lead to the Underdark.
- (2026-06-04) The party followed a switchback trail from the road into the mountains to reach the abandoned monastery.
- (2026-07-30) The party entered the foothills guided by Dandrick, avoiding the monitored main pass at Vestalin.

chunks.title: Militia Stockade
chunks.text:
Location: Militia Stockade (first seen 2026-01-29, last seen 2026-01-29) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Barracks stables
Type: fortress
Parent: Alderville
- (2026-01-29) Muto and Garuet pitched the homestead plan to Captain Samson here.

chunks.title: Stand of Trees near Mountain Inn
names: Stand of Trees near Mountain Inn
chunks.text:
Location: Stand of Trees near Mountain Inn (first seen 2026-02-12, last seen 2026-02-12) [unconfirmed record]
Type: copse of woods
Parent: Alderville
Description: Small copse between the Countess's estate and the Mountain Inn
- (2026-02-12) Ronan was seen ducking into these trees and the party and militia searched them without finding him.
- (2026-02-12) Allyn found fresh size 14 boot prints there showing someone hid and circled back toward the Mountain Inn's rear.

chunks.title: Mountain Inn Stable Yard
chunks.text:
Location: Mountain Inn Stable Yard (first seen 2026-02-12, last seen 2026-02-12) [unconfirmed record]
Type: campground and stable yard
Parent: Mountain Inn
Description: Nobles' carriages and horses under a pavilion tent, guarded by caravan guards, drivers and footmen
- (2026-02-12) The party scouted it and judged the guards not overly vigilant.

chunks.title: Glowing Fungus Cavern
chunks.text:
Location: Glowing Fungus Cavern (first seen 2026-03-26, last seen 2026-03-26) [unconfirmed record]
Type: cavern
Parent: Underdark
Description: Very large cavern lit by patches of glowing fungus and lichen, with a shallow stream and several cave exits.
- (2026-03-26) The party was ambushed by stirges here and collected fungus samples.

chunks.title: The Glade
chunks.text:
Location: The Glade (first seen 2026-03-26, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Alderwood Glade
Type: glade
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Peaceful sunlit glade where the underground stream emerges, with a second cave entrance and a narrower stream channel nearby.
- (2026-03-26) The party emerged here at evening after following birdsong downstream.
- (2026-04-09) The party emerged at dusk, spent a peaceful undisturbed night beside a babbling brook and divided loot.

chunks.title: Subterranean Waterway
chunks.text:
Location: Subterranean Waterway (first seen 2026-04-09, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Large Flooded Chamber
Type: flooded cave system
Parent: Underdark
Description: Dark streamlet with rushing ankle-to-knee-deep water opening into a larger flooded chamber with a shingle beach and two dry cave entrances; levels rise with heavy rain outside.
- (2026-04-09) Asher rode on Elric's back to avoid wading.
- (2026-04-09) Muto concluded from watermarks that the flow was an outflow from deeper within.

chunks.title: Descending Passage
chunks.text:
Location: Descending Passage (first seen 2026-04-09, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Type: tunnel
Parent: Subterranean Waterway
Description: Fairly straight, smooth-floored tunnel that slopes downward with signs of past water flow.
- (2026-04-09) Allyn and Muto noticed the floor descending, and the party backtracked, suspecting it leads deeper into the Underdark.

chunks.title: Spiral Passage
chunks.text:
Location: Spiral Passage (first seen 2026-04-09, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Rising Passage
Type: tunnel
Parent: Subterranean Waterway
Description: Naturally formed ramp-like corkscrew rising from the flooded caverns, with rough walls and a water-smoothed floor.
- (2026-04-09) Muto judged it more natural than manufactured, though such formation seemed unlikely on its own.

chunks.title: Luminous Fungus Chamber
chunks.text:
Location: Luminous Fungus Chamber (first seen 2026-04-09, last seen 2026-04-09) [unconfirmed record]
Type: cavern
Parent: Underdark
Description: Large cavern with purple and green glowing lichen, a five-foot drop and a deep crevasse from which the Beetle Knights emerged.
- (2026-04-09) Asher found specimens matching Carder Mane's shopping list and collected samples.
- (2026-04-09) Elric nearly fell into the crevasse but caught his balance.
- (2026-04-09) The Beetle Knights and hulking creature ambushed the party here and were killed.

chunks.title: Umber Hulk Tunnel
chunks.text:
Location: Umber Hulk Tunnel (first seen 2026-04-23, last seen 2026-04-23) [unconfirmed record]
Type: tunnel
Parent: Underdark
Description: Rough-hewn burrowed passage dropping about 50-60 feet to a nest of bones and molted carapaces.
- (2026-04-23) Muto's owl scouted the nest and he descended as a giant spider to retrieve a hidden treasure parcel.

chunks.title: Spider Cleft
chunks.text:
Location: Spider Cleft (first seen 2026-04-23, last seen 2026-04-23) [unconfirmed record]
Type: fissure
Parent: Alderwood
Description: Deep narrow fissure serving as an entrance to the underground tunnels.
- (2026-04-23) The party followed a watercourse back to the Spider Cleft and climbed out to the surface.

chunks.title: The Ravine
chunks.text:
Location: The Ravine (first seen 2026-04-23, last seen 2026-04-23) [unconfirmed record]
Type: chasm
Parent: Underdark
Description: Deep chasm with narrow points about 10 feet across.
- (2026-04-23) The party crossed the ravine using ropes and Muto's spider form without incident.

chunks.title: Lumber Mill
chunks.text:
Location: Lumber Mill (first seen 2026-05-07, last seen 2026-05-07) [unconfirmed record]
Type: mill
Parent: Alderville
Description: South of town near the river; site of the Garuet and Ronan duel.
- (2026-05-07) Garuet defeated Ronan in an honor duel here at high noon.

chunks.title: Caravansarai
chunks.text:
Location: Caravansarai (first seen 2026-05-07, last seen 2026-05-07) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: caravanserai
Type: staging area
Parent: Alderville
Description: Near the palisade; visiting nobles' carriages and animals are marshaled here.
- (2026-05-07) Asher spoke with grumbling noble guards here about Ronan's dismissal.

chunks.title: Jessain
chunks.text:
Location: Jessain (first seen 2026-05-21, last seen 2026-07-30) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Jesain, Josain, Josaine
Type: city
Description: Coastal city, once the heart of Pfilen's trade empire, now under Elanthan occupation.
- (2026-05-21) The party chose to travel north through Jessain to sell unneeded items and let Garuet gather information about her people.
- (2026-06-04) The party intends to sell loot in Jesain and Garuet hopes to find other Goliaths there.
- (2026-06-18) The party is a few days' travel from Jessain and agreed to enter openly.
- (2026-07-02) The party entered Jessain posing as traders from Aldervale, with Asher as the merchant and Garuet and Allyn as guards.
- (2026-07-02) The city gate was manned by Elanthan soldiers who required all weapons to be peace-bonded.
- (2026-07-02) The city has damaged fortifications, boarded-up businesses and a thin, hurried populace, and most market trade is barter.
- (2026-07-30) The party left Pfilen after downtime and obtained cold weather gear before heading to the mountains.

chunks.title: Gem Lakes
chunks.text:
Location: Gem Lakes (first seen 2026-05-21, last seen 2026-05-21) [unconfirmed record]
Type: region
Description: Site of the monastery and archives of Brother Elric's order.
- (2026-05-21) The party agreed to go to the Gem Lakes after Jessain, to deliver the Countess's missive.

chunks.title: Abandoned Mountain Monastery
chunks.text:
Location: Abandoned Mountain Monastery (first seen 2026-06-04, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: abandoned holdfast, mountain temple, Abandoned Mountain Temple
Type: monastic holdfast
Parent: Berius Mountains
Description: Built into a cliff face with wide stone stairs, carved columns, a dried fountain, collapsed rooms and flooded chambers; no doors.
- (2026-06-04) The monastery was the lair of a wight and its ghasts until the party cleared it.
- (2026-06-04) The party took a long rest there after clearing it.
- (2026-06-04) The GM noted the monastery could be recovered and made functional.
- (2026-06-18) The party rested here and discussed using it as a bastion or refugee waypoint on the road to Muto's homestead.
- (2026-06-18) The party found a sinkhole in the deeper cavern, with a roughly 100-foot drop.

chunks.title: Fort Beria
chunks.text:
Location: Fort Beria (first seen 2026-06-04, last seen 2026-06-04) [unconfirmed record]
Type: military outpost
Description: Elanthan outpost used as a staging point for Redhawk recruits sent north into Pfilen.

chunks.title: Crystal Cavern
chunks.text:
Location: Crystal Cavern (first seen 2026-06-18, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
Type: underground chamber
Parent: Abandoned Mountain Monastery
Description: Large chamber about 100 feet below the temple, dimly lit by glowing quartz crystals and luminous fungus.
- (2026-06-18) Muto's owl familiar scouted it and was destroyed by a spectral undead.
- (2026-06-18) The party chose not to explore it further.

chunks.title: Mountain Stream Ford
chunks.text:
Location: Mountain Stream Ford (first seen 2026-06-18, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
Type: river crossing
Parent: Pfilen
Description: Natural ford about ten feet wide, calm at the crossing and faster and deeper downstream, with brush and rocky bluffs.
- (2026-06-18) Bugbear stalkers ambushed the party here.

chunks.title: Pfilen
chunks.text:
Location: Pfilen (first seen 2026-06-18, last seen 2026-06-18) [unconfirmed record]
Type: kingdom
Description: Former coastal monarchy under Elanthan occupation, known for trade, fishing and gold from Vestalin.
- (2026-06-18) The party descended into Pfilen from the mountain pass.
- (2026-06-18) Elanthan forces, the Redhawks and the Flayers resistance operate there.

chunks.title: Bugbear Encampment
chunks.text:
Location: Bugbear Encampment (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-02) [unconfirmed record]
Type: camp
Parent: Pfilen
Description: Small temporary camp near the ford, base of five bugbears.
- (2026-07-02) The party followed tracks from the ford to the camp and looted it.

chunks.title: Smith Brothers Bakery
chunks.text:
Location: Smith Brothers Bakery (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-02) [unconfirmed record]
Type: bakery
Parent: Jessain
Description: Still operating despite hard times, with a breadline outside and a back courtyard.
- (2026-07-02) The party traded flour here for a letter of credit for bread.

chunks.title: The Salty Sailor
chunks.text:
Location: The Salty Sailor (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Type: inn
Parent: Jessain
Description: Once middle-class, now a rough inn with tough-looking patrons.
- (2026-07-02) Allyn and Garuet met Thea here and then Baron LeFlay in a back room.
- (2026-07-16) Baron LeFlay met the party in the back room twice this session and revealed himself as Coordinator of the Flares.

chunks.title: Silent Step Shrine
chunks.text:
Location: Silent Step Shrine (first seen 2026-07-02, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Shrine of the Silent Step
Type: shrine
Parent: Jessain
Description: Modest religious site with a flat roof used as a lookout, where the brothers distribute bread.
- (2026-07-02) The party delivered the letter of credit here and shared a meal and information with the monks.
- (2026-07-02) Muto's Detect Portal ritual found no portals nearby.
- (2026-07-16) Elanthan soldiers tried to disperse the bread crowd here and were turned away.

chunks.title: Finston's Curio Shop
chunks.text:
Location: Finston's Curio Shop (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Type: shop
Parent: Jessain
Description: Narrow, dim, dusty shop full of mechanical clocks and minor oddities; only two customers at a time.
- (2026-07-16) Asher and Muto traded items here for an Orb of Direction and a self-mending cloak.

chunks.title: The Smithy
chunks.text:
Location: The Smithy (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Type: smithy
Parent: Jessain
Description: West-side smithy run by a burly human and several dwarves; forge fits three workers.
- (2026-07-16) The party sold its bugbear gear here and arranged evening forge use.

chunks.title: Uncommon Scents
chunks.text:
Location: Uncommon Scents (first seen 2026-07-16, last seen 2026-07-16) [unconfirmed record]
Type: perfumery
Parent: Jessain
Description: Fragrant perfumery run by the tiefling Giselle with potion and ink making facilities.
- (2026-07-16) Asher traded a boggle skin here for rare magical inks.

chunks.title: Wyatt's Leather Works
chunks.text:
Location: Wyatt's Leather Works (first seen 2026-07-30, last seen 2026-07-30) [unconfirmed record]
Type: leatherworking shop
Parent: Pfilen
Description: Well-appointed shop near the West Gate catering to prospectors and trappers, with a back room of hide stacks.
- (2026-07-30) The party bought tailored cold weather gear here at half price.

chunks.title: Dickle
chunks.text:
Location: Dickle (first seen 2026-07-30, last seen 2026-08-27) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Ruined Village Graveyard
Type: ruined village
Parent: Barriest Mountains foothills
Description: Ruined village on a goat path into the mountains with a graveyard, mausoleums and a large dead tree at its center, shrouded in mist under moonlight.
- (2026-07-30) Muto sensed a residual echo of a recently used rift to the north of Dickle.
- (2026-07-30) The party was ambushed here by a zombie troll and four Harrowhounds.
- (2026-07-30) After the fight Muto heard humming from the direction of the graveyard.
- (2026-08-13) The party fought the Annis Hag, Harrowhounds, a Harrowhawk and a giant zombie in the graveyard and won.
- (2026-08-13) Asher's Detect Magic found the mist non-magical, just graveyard fog.
- (2026-08-13) Muto's Detect Portal confirmed rifts had been opened nearby, with only faint traces.
- (2026-08-27) The party rested in the smaller mausoleums overnight and left the graveyard following Dandrick.
- (2026-08-27) Muto's Detect Portal found residue of a recently closed rift, and the party learned the barrow ghast was stitched from remains of those buried there.

chunks.title: The Sepulcher
chunks.text:
Location: The Sepulcher (first seen 2026-08-13, last seen 2026-08-13) [unconfirmed record]
Type: mausoleum
Parent: Dickle
Description: Stone mausoleum in the graveyard from which the hag retreated and the giant zombie emerged.
- (2026-08-13) The giant zombie emerged from the Sepulcher during the battle.

chunks.title: Hidden Dell
chunks.text:
Location: Hidden Dell (first seen 2026-08-27, last seen 2026-09-24) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: hidden Goliath village, Goliath Mountain Village
Type: hidden village
Parent: Barriest Mountains
Description: Dell with a clear pool fed by a mountain stream, hidden by an illusion that looks like a dead-end ravine, holding about twenty-five to thirty Goliaths.
- (2026-08-27) Torchrunner led the party into the ravine, where the illusion dropped to reveal the village.
- (2026-09-10) The party hosted at breakfast and held a bulette-heart victory feast here.

Plot Thread: Recover Uton's old homestead (first seen 2025-08-14, last seen 2026-03-12)

Hook: Muto wants to recover his father Uton's abandoned homestead during the Triskelion and learn what happened there.
Status: advanced
Linked: Muto's father Uton, Triskelion
- (2025-08-14) Muto proposed going to his father's old homestead during the Triskelion, when the aligned moons change the area, to finally learn what happened there and recover the place.
- (2025-08-14) The party agreed to go along; Brother Elric also wanted to tend refugees who gather at the festival seeking a boon from the druids.
- (2025-08-14) The homestead is about half a day's travel from town; Muto led the party through the woods for a couple of hours.
- (2025-08-14) A harpy had nested in the house at night and outside by day; the house was ransacked and fouled, with a pile of partly eaten cadavers in the back. Its structure is intact, but it would need gutting and rebuilding to be lived in.
- (2025-08-14) The well is still drinkable, the fruit trees are dead, and the cart could be repaired to haul the bodies to town.
- (2025-08-14) The GM counted the session's short-term goal as completed by Muto, worth a 5% milestone bonus.
- (2025-08-14) Muto wants to bury the bodies the next day; the party left the house because night and the Triskelion were falling.
- (2025-08-28) The party wrapped the dead in rugs and camped at the homestead before moving on to the Triskelion mission.

chunks.title: Recover Uton's old homestead (part 2)

- (2026-03-12) Muto delivered the Countess's letter and got the Mayor's support for resettling refugees at the homestead.
- (2026-03-12) The party escorted refugee families and Andric to the homestead and settled them in with tools, a plow, weapons and crossbows.

chunks.title: Uton's lost memory
chunks.text:

Status: open

- (2025-08-14) Uton was not himself that day. He laughed at nothing, pointed at corners, and said he missed the old house and that there were too many people in the shop.
- (2025-08-14) Carter Maine has tried a number of remedies and nothing has worked. Uton can go days lucid and then lapse.
- (2025-08-14) Muto hopes retaking the old house might solve it and wants to learn anything about Uton's time away.
- (2025-10-23) The grinning cat revealed Muto's father once stayed with her queen in the Feywild and forgot much of it.
- (2025-10-23) She said the stories are the queen's business to tell.
- (2025-11-06) Uton remembered the Fae Muto named and revealed he traded twenty years of his life in the Feywild.

chunks.title: Red Hawks and the army officer

chunks.text:

Status: open

- (2025-08-14) Five Red Hawk recruits drinking their recruitment bonus harassed a Filanese girl at Refugee Camp Number 11; the party fought them with non-lethal blows until they surrendered.
- (2025-08-14) A Red Hawk sergeant and a regular-army rider watched from a distance; she stared intently at Allyn and Brother Elric, gave a two-finger salute and rode off with the beaten recruits.
- (2025-08-14) The army officer belongs to a unit none of the party recognizes, probably formed after the barbarian revolt. He deferred to the sergeant collegially.
- (2025-08-14) Captain Holcroft thanked the party, said Mayor Woodson would want to speak with them, and hid them in a tower to keep out of sight in case of repercussions; the mayor's daughter greeted them after about an hour.
- (2025-08-14) Corwynn, Muto and the others noted that Filanese refugees are barred from carrying more than a dagger.
- (2025-11-20) The party found a dead former Red Hawk at the wrecked wagon who mistook Corwynn for someone.
- (2025-12-04) The dead mercenary at the carnage site wore Red Hawk armor with its emblem removed.
- (2026-01-29) The ledger linked the Redhawks' colonel to payments from House Jorund.

- (2025-08-14) Two decomposed bodies lay near the house; one had pale skin and blonde hair, and they had been dead from a few days to a couple of weeks. More cadavers were inside. The GM will list their belongings before next session.

- (2025-08-28) Asher's Arcana check of 24 taught the party that rifts may pulse to deliver more creatures and need time to recharge.
- (2025-08-28) Verdina explained that Ceremony can upgrade rifts into portals, making them twice as hard to close.
- (2025-08-28) The party chose to head to location C, the closest remaining rift, and fought six mephits on the way.
- (2025-09-11) The party destroyed the stone table and closed the second rift, a Feywild rift, before it became a portal.
- (2025-09-11) Goblins were performing a ritual to make the rift permanent.
- (2025-09-11) The party leveled up to level 2 as a milestone.
- (2025-09-11) More portals remain to be sealed.
- (2025-09-25) The party had closed rifts C and D and still needed to close A and B.
- (2025-09-25) The party found rift B in a clearing of standing stones guarded by fiendish creatures.
- (2025-09-25) Magic Missile from Asher had no effect on the rift, and Asher determined it needed melee damage.
- (2025-09-25) The party attacked the rift in melee while something began clawing through; the session ended on that cliffhanger.
